coverage: Pages using Item Infobox or Armor Infobox, plus numeric recipes in the Ingredients table. Unlock conditions and dynamic drop tables are not fully imported.

items.name: Abyssal Wing Axe
items.description: The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.

items.name: Abysswalker
items.description: A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively.

items.name: Acid Bite
items.description: Magical ammunition that sprays acid in a cone in front of the caster, poisoning all enemies hit.

items.name: Acid Cleaver
items.description: A cleaver coated with acid and bile. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.
items.acquisition: Acid Cleaver can be dropped by the . C:Early Access Launch

items.name: Acidic Mycelium
items.description: Acidic Mycelium mined in the Nomad Highlands.
items.acquisition: Mined from glowing green patches of ground in the Nomad Highlands Shroud. fr:Mycélium acide

items.name: Active Mycelium
items.description: The active mycelium of mushrooms absorbs the Shroud's magical properties. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
items.acquisition: Mined from glowing blue mycelium patches, found throughout Embervale, primarily in the Shroud. fr:Mycélium actif

items.name: Adorned Drakling Daggers
items.description: Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.

items.name: Advanced Glider
items.description: This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.

items.name: Advanced Rake
items.description: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.

items.name: Adventurer Boots
items.description: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.

items.name: Adventurer Chest
items.description: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.

items.name: Adventurer Gloves
items.description: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.

items.name: Adventurer Helmet
items.description: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.

items.name: Adventurer Trousers
items.description: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.

items.name: Aerated Banshee Gel
items.description: A lightweight, protective gel. Has properties of Fell magic.
items.acquisition: Aerated Banshee Gel is dropped by Fell Banshees, first found in the Springlands Shroud. fr:Gel de Banshee aéré

items.name: Aerostriker
items.description: A heavy hammer that strikes true, like a bird of prey.

items.name: Albaneve Summits Bone Key
items.description: Opens doors in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.

items.name: Albaneve Summits Dirt
items.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment.
items.acquisition: Springlands Dirt can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Alchemical Base
items.description: A clear liquid with a sharp smell. Used to enhance alchemical reactions.

items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Boots
items.description: Simple leather boots — a perfect fit.

items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Chest
items.description: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.

items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Gloves
items.description: Starting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.

items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Hat
items.description: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.

items.name: Alchemist Apprentice Trousers
items.description: Comfortable trousers for long walks.

items.name: Alchemist Showcase
items.description: Use this showcase to reassemble an alchemist's notes. Completing the collection will unlock new recipes.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving all both pieces of the Alchemist's Wall Hanging, during the quest .

items.name: Alchemist's Ring
items.description: A ring with glowing blue engravings that read: "May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"

items.name: Alchemy Station
items.description: An Alchemy Station offering all needed tools to craft better alchemical products.
items.acquisition: Crafting the Alchemy Station completes , after obtaining a during the quest. Additional Alchemy Stations can be crafted at the Alchemist after completing the quest.

items.name: Algae
items.description: These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
items.acquisition: Algae is obtained from Algae plants found underwater in the Veilwater Basin biome. Algae can also be grown from Algae Seedlings. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Algae Buds
items.description: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.

items.name: Algae Salad
items.description: An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.

items.name: Algae Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed when harvesting Algae or Algae Buds for the first time, which can be found underwater in Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Almanac of Plants and Seedlings
items.description: Explains how to grow all sorts of seedlings.
items.acquisition: The Almanac of Plants and Seedlings is obtained from a Scavenger Matron in in the Nomad Highlands, as part of .

items.name: Aloe
items.description: This desert plant contains a slimy liquid, which is know to have medical applications. Used in alchemy.
items.acquisition: Aloe is obtained by chopping down Aloe plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Aloe plants can also be grown from Aloe Seedlings. fr:Aloès

items.name: Aloe Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Aloe Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Aloe for the first time. Aloe can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Alpine Antler Boots
items.description: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!

items.name: Alpine Antler Chest
items.description: A blue overcoat with a fluffy, snow-white trim to keep warm. The pelts are lightweight and won't weigh you down when scaling the mountain tops to find vantage points.

items.name: Alpine Antler Gloves
items.description: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.

items.name: Alpine Antler Hood
items.description: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.

items.name: Alpine Antler Trousers
items.description: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.

items.name: Alpine Rose Pot
items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home

items.name: Amber
items.description: Created through years of petrification, it has become a beautiful material used for production.
items.acquisition: Mined from red amber veins in the Revelwood Shroud. Several deposits of amber can be found in the deep shroud cavity between Abandoned Hunter Camp and Hidden Hollow Tomb, north of Revelwood Ancient Spire. fr:Ambre

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: A beautiful mineral, usually found beneath the Shroud. Its color can range from a deep and saturated royal purple to a light, lavender hue.
items.acquisition: fr:Améthyste

items.name: Ammonia Gland
items.description: This gland contains a concentrated substance which can be used to tan furs.
items.acquisition: Ammonia Glands are dropped by Fell Mushroom Crabs in the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud (notably Umber Hollow). fr:Glande d'ammoniac

items.name: Ammonite Imprint
items.description: A stone with multiple large ammonite imprints. There's a bewitching spiral shape on every side of it.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Springlands.

items.name: Ancestral Star
items.description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".
items.acquisition: Ancestral Star can be found at .

items.name: Ancient Drak Wand
items.description: A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

items.name: Animal Fur
items.description: Warm and comfortable during yearfall. A versatile resource that is very common and can be used for many things.
items.acquisition: Animal Fur is crafted by the Hunter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. Animal Fur is also a common drop from wildlife and Vukah. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.

items.name: Antique
items.description: Softspoken, sandy browns, and bright ash colors give this palette a dusty, but distinguished look. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.acquisition: The Antique dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Antiseptic
items.description: A medical solution to prevent wound infections. Among other things, it can be used to disinfect bandages.

items.name: Antler Bow
items.description: Designed in admiration of antlers, this bow has an imperial and awe-inspiring image.

items.name: Apex Machete
items.description: The weapon brandishes an interlocking pattern of dark and light by partially covering its fuller with a blackened outer shell. The sword's sides are asymmetric, making one ideal for slashing while the other excels in prying or hacking through its pronounced claw-like appendage.

items.name: Apprentice Wand
items.description: Modified to increase the mana control, this wand shoots ice projectiles with a bit more force.

items.name: Aquamarine
items.description: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.
items.acquisition: C:Wake Of Water Update fr:Aigue-marine

items.name: Aquamarine Dreams
items.description: A luminous blend of crystal blues and soft turquoise hues captures the shimmering depths of clear waters. Calm yet vibrant, this palette radiates the freshness and clarity of aquamarine crystals, exuding a quiet elegance. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Aquamarine Dreams dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station after being found/unlocked at the .

items.name: Aquamarine Dust
items.description: Finely ground Aquamarine crystals that sparkle beautifully.

items.name: Archaic Essence (13)
items.description: A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison.
items.acquisition: Archaic Essense can be found by harvesting the yellow bulbs found in Revelwood Shroud Lairs. Bulbs may also be found in the Shroud Gazer tunnels found behind some Fell spawners.

items.acquisition: Archaic Essense can be found by harvesting the yellow bulbs found in Springlands Shroud Lairs. Bulbs may also be found in the Shroud Gazer tunnels found behind some Fell spawners.

items.name: Archer Boots
items.description: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.

items.name: Archer Chest
items.description: The leather on this nature-bound armor piece was layered to resemble the leaves of a blossoming forest.

items.name: Archer Gloves
items.description: These Archer Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.

items.name: Archer Helmet
items.description: An archer's hood. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.

items.name: Archer Trousers
items.description: The coloring of these pants allows the wearer to seamlessly blend into the foliage.

items.name: Archmage Boots
items.description: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.

items.name: Archmage Chest
items.description: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.

items.name: Archmage Gloves
items.description: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.

items.name: Archmage Hat
items.description: This magical hat was decorated with fine metal spines that reach out to the stars. It only graces the brightest minds in Embervale!

items.name: Archmage Trousers
items.description: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.

items.name: Arsonist's Bow
items.description: A bow that sparks blazing joy in firebugs and aspiring pyromaniacs.

items.name: Assassin Boots
items.description: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.

items.name: Assassin Chest
items.description: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.

items.name: Assassin Gloves
items.description: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.

items.name: Assassin Hood
items.description: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.

items.name: Assassin Trousers
items.description: A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.

items.name: Athanor
items.description: A complex oven used by scholars of the alchemical mysteries.
items.acquisition: The Athanor can be crafted at the Alchemist when Scientific Instruments are obtained during the quest Scientific Instruments for a Laboratory.

items.name: Aureolin Flower
items.description: A beautiful yellow flower with magical properties that increases the user's mana.
items.acquisition: Aureolin Flower is obtained from Aureolin Flowers, found in the Springlands biome. Aureolin Flowers can also be grown from Aureolin Flower Seedlings. fr:Fleur d'auréoline

items.name: Aureolin Flower Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Aureolin Flower for the first time. Aureolin Flower can be found in the Springlands.

items.name: Aureolin Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Aurora Sword
items.description: All incoming light fractures on the surface of this elegant blade, creating a dancing ensemble of floating colors. It is practically dripping with excellence.

items.name: Avalanche Starter
items.description: When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Axe
items.description: A primitive tool used for cutting wood. It can also be used as a weapon in a pinch.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.

items.name: Azure Russula
items.description: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.
items.acquisition: Azure Russula is obtained from Azure Russula mushrooms, first found in the Revelwood biome. They are often found in caves. Azure Russulas can also be grown from Azure Russula Seedlings.

items.name: Azure Russula Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Azure Russula for the first time. Azure Russula can be found in Caves or in the Shroud.

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

items.description: This item heals 40% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.

items.name: Banebringer
items.description: A infested Shroud bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.

items.name: Barbarian Greatsword
items.description: Miscreants, brutes, and evil doers of the past would often wield similar blades. Perhaps this weapon was forged in the shadows of a back alley and changed hands on the black market.

items.name: Baroness Daggers
items.description: An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber.

items.name: Battering Ram Hammer
items.description: A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!

items.name: Batwing Axe
items.description: The blades of this axe have sharp edges that flow into an upper peak. They were crafted like that to break through frozen lake surfaces or walls and resemble bat wings.

items.name: Beef Stew
items.description: A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.

items.name: Beehive
items.description: Anything can be domesticated with enough patience. Used to produce honey and wax.
items.acquisition: The Beehive is created by the Farmer after completing the quest and collecting the from the Vukah Brawler to craft it.

items.name: Beehive Smoker
items.description: Unlocks the ability to craft a Honey Beehive that provides honey and wax regularly.
items.acquisition: The Beehive Smoker is obtained from a Vukah Brawler atop in the Kindlewastes, as part of for the Farmer.

items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Forest Beet for the first time. Forest Beet can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Bejeweled Golden Urn
items.description: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Bell Pepper
items.description: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.
items.acquisition: Bell Pepper is obtained from Bell Pepper plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Bell Peppers can also be grown from Bell Pepper Seedlings. fr:Poivron

items.description: Food for attracting and taming a Flightless Redtail or a Round-Billed Sailer.

items.description: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?

items.name: Blood Rose Boots

items.name: Blood Rose Chestplate

items.acquisition: Blood Rose Chestplate is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin

items.name: Blood Rose Gloves

items.acquisition: Blood Rose Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin

items.name: Blood Rose Mail Coif
items.description: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair - they all coalesce in her halo.
items.acquisition: Blood Rose Mail Coif is a unique drop that can be found in the Veilwater Basin

items.name: Blood Rose Pants

items.description: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.

items.name: Brazen Bull Chest
items.description: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.

items.name: Brazen Bull Gloves
items.description: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.

items.name: Brazen Bull Helmet
items.description: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.

items.name: Brazen Bull Shield
items.description: The goat head imprinted on this metal shield is imposing, looking down on its adversaries with a stalwart gaze.

items.description: A wonderfully inviting fireplace made from red bricks

items.name: Brick-Timbered Block
items.description: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting a silver chest found deep in the sewers beneath . The door to access the room with the chest must be picked in order to open. One way to reach them is on the North East side of Fort Kelvin underneath a construction crane with a grapple point next to the ruins of a red brick building there is a stairway down. Take the stairs down to arrive at a muddy sewer canal. Follow the canal to the right and take the first left then continue forward to a set of rusted, locked bar doors on your left. Go through the doors and down another set of stairs to a muddy room with a silver chest containing the blocks.

items.name: Bright Morningstar
items.description: A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.

items.name: Bright Resolve
items.description: The brightness of the yellow tinge makes it appear almost fluorescent. While shining brighter than the sun, the thought of defeat becomes lost in radiance. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Bright Resolve dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Brisk Bow
items.description: Every true shot makes the blood pump faster.

items.description: If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.
items.acquisition: Brittle Shroud Flakes are obtained by chopping down mushroom stalks in the Kindlewastes Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms. fr:Flocons de Brume fragiles

items.name: Brittle Shroud Petals
items.description: Delicate petals tainted by the Shroud. Their surface is coated in a faint, toxic residue. Though fragile on their own, they are surprisingly resilient when woven into armor.
items.acquisition: Brittle Shroud Petals are dropped by Fell Vicious Vines, first found in the Revelwood Shroud. fr:Pétales de Brume fragiles

It is believed that she guides their hand - ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.

items.name: Chanterelle
items.description: It tastes incredibly bitter when raw, but develops a zesty aroma while cooked.
items.acquisition: The item was added as part of the Souls of the Frozen Frontier update so the shroud areas in Albaneve Summits contain this item. Specifically, many Chanterelle can be found close to the Watchtower point of interest in the shroud directly north of the Nomad Heights spire. Note, These are rather small and can be missed with ease if your not looking down towards the ground. Note, for easier farming of this item there are several patches of this mushroom just south west of the Ancient Spire Albaneve Summits, See picture for details

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Created in a kiln under high temperatures. Burned wood mixed with oxygen creates a flammable material, highly convenient and needed to dive into the world of craftsmanship.

items.name: Charcoal Kiln

items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted at the Blacksmith.

items.name: Chicken Soup
items.description: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness

items.name: Chief Drak'Dal Axe
items.description: Those who wield the Chief Drak'Dal Axe command great awe - one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.

items.name: Chieftain's Hammer
items.description: An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.

items.name: Chimerical Greatsword
items.description: A weapon born from the amalgamation of bones, earth, and liquid fire. As your eyes travel across it, the mess of cartilage and moss at the hilt gives way to a light-swallowing obsidian blade.

items.name: Chitin Powder

items.name: Circlet Of Lightning

items.name: Circular Sawblades

items.description: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out!

items.acquisition: A hint is placed in the Set List after reading . This block is then obtained by looting the Citywall Block in . It is found in a silver chest on one of the scaffolds behind the tower guarded by the Scavenger Matron. leads to the same location, but the tower is further in.

items.description: The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy.

items.description: A wooden coaster to display drinks on a table.

items.description: A cold smoothie made from coconuts and bananas. Best served with a little decorative umbrella, a cozy spot on the beach, and two swirly straws.

items.name: Coconut
items.description: A fresh coconut, plucked directly from a palm tree. The water inside can be drunk as is or processed into milk.
items.acquisition: Can be obtained from chopping Coconut Palm trees or harvested from fully grown Coconut Palm Seedlings.

items.name: Coconut Milk
items.description: This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.

items.name: Coconut Palm Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed when harvesting Coconut for the first time, which can be found in Veilwater Basin.

items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home

items.description: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor.

items.description: A handy machine that brews hot coffee. There is hope left in this world after all.
items.acquisition: The Coffee Brewery is obtained during along with the Coffee Drum Roaster.

items.description: A machine that's used to roast coffee beans. Necessary to make coffee.
items.acquisition: The Coffee Drum Roaster is obtained during along with the Coffee Brewery.

items.description: A simple and sturdy ring, decorated with 3 azure gemstones. The engraving reads: "To Cyrus, my most loyal Commander and friend" It was found inside the maw of the creature that haunts The Pike.

items.description: Bait that increases the chance of catching common fish.

items.name: Composite Bow
items.description: This is a very sophisticated bow with hight tension.

items.name: Conifer Logs
items.description: The raw and untreated wood of conifer trees. They fill the air with a fresh smell of pine needles and sweet resin.
items.acquisition: Conifer Logs are obtained from chopping down Conifer Trees, found in the Albaneve Summits biome. The amount obtained is determined by the tree's size, larger trees produce more logs. Along with the logs you can obtain Twigs and Resin. Better Axes chop trees faster, along with the Mother's Eye to increase chopping strength.

items.name: Conifer Tree Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Conifer Wood Block
items.description: A cozy, darker wood block made from conifer logs. It makes you want to hunt in the mountains or to drink hot tea by the fire.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Conifer Logs for the first time.

items.name: Construction Hammer
items.description: Hammer of the Ancients: An archaic building tool fueled by the Flame, capable of quickly erecting various structures around your home.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by reaching the Return Beacon past the caves after exiting the Cinder Vault for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.

items.name: Cooked Fae Deer Milk
items.description: A delicious jug of Fae Deer milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!

items.name: Cooked Rice
items.description: This cooked rice is delicious and vaguely aromatic. It will make for a good side dish.

items.name: Cooking Station
items.description: A basic setup for preparing meals
items.acquisition: Cooking Station is crafted by the Farmer. The crafting recipe requires accepting to unlock.

items.description: An arrow with a copper tip

items.name: Copper Axe
items.description: A sharp Copper Axe which is highly efficient at cutting wood. It can also be used to cut down enemies.

items.name: Copper Bars
items.description: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.
items.acquisition: Copper Bars are crafted by the Smelter or by the Blast Furnace. The Blast Furnace smelts Copper Bars faster but requires instead of . The crafting recipe requires obtaining a during to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.

items.name: Copper Block
items.description: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Copper Bar for the first time. Copper Bars can be crafted by combining Charcoal and Copper Ore in the Smelter or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Copper Ore can be found all over Revelwood.

items.description: A very versatile crop that can be dried, grilled or consumed raw, strengthening the consumer for a short duration.
items.acquisition: Corncob is obtained from Corn plants, found in the Springlands biome. Each Corn plant gives you x3 corncobs. Corncobs can also be grown from Corn Seedlings. fr:Épi de maïs

items.name: Corrosive Blood
items.description: A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items.
items.acquisition: Corrosive Blood is dropped by Fell ennemies, first found in the Nomad Highlands Shroud. FR:Sang corrosif

items.name: Corrosive Daggers
items.description: These blades were corroded by being submerged in poison for too long.

items.name: Corrupted Boar Tusk
items.description: A jagged tusk that's been tainted by the Shroud. Pulsing with faint traces of toxic energy.
items.acquisition: Corrupted Boar Tusk is dropped by Fell Boars, found in the Revelwood Shroud.

items.name: Cowlick Wig Head
items.description: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.
items.acquisition: The Cowlick Wig Head can be found in Surat's Rest.

items.name: Crab Cakes
items.description: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.

items.name: Crab Fossil
items.description: Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Crab Meat
items.description: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.
items.acquisition: Crab Meat is dropped by Crabs and Drak. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Crackling Wand
items.description: Fire proves to be an excellent weapon against creatures of the Shroud.

items.name: Creamy Mushroom Spaetzle
items.description: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.

items.name: Crimson Valor
items.description: The rose-red accents on the ivory background add a romantic flair, painting the wearer to be a charming, valiant hero. This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Crimson Valor dye can be found at the .

items.name: Crimsonback
items.description: The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.
items.acquisition: Crimsonback can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like , and . C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Critter Carapace
items.description: A carapace that protects the soft flesh underneath.
items.acquisition: Critter Carapace is dropped by Fell Critters in Albaneve Summits or Veilwater Basin Shroud areas. fr:Carapace de bestioles

items.name: Critter Glands
items.description: A pair of slippery Glands.
items.acquisition: Critter Glands is dropped by flying Fell Critters, found in the Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud.

items.acquisition: Critter Parts is a common drop from the Fell Critters found in the Springlands and Revelwood Shroud. fr:Morceaux de bestioles

items.name: Critter Plush

items.acquisition: It can be found in Pikemead's Reach during the quest given by the Barber. It can be crafted at the Farmer afterwards.

items.description: A Shroud-tainted wand which radiates darkness. You feel that using it will widen a hidden void beneath Embervale, slowly growing in obscurity, swallowing all around...but perhaps using it once or twice won't hurt?

items.description: Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.

items.description: A doomed fishing rod that is more likely to either catch valuables or junk. Well, one man's trash is another man's treasure!

items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.

items.description: A bony Cyclops pelvis. It's eerie.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Cyclops Showcase
items.description: A trophy stand, used to prop up the skeleton of a Cyclops.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving any of the seven pieces of the Cyclops Skeleton.

items.name: Cyclops Skull
items.description: A gruesome, skeletal Cyclops head. You can fit your entire fist through the giant eyehole!

items.name: Dark Cleaver
items.description: Cleave through it all. Part the Shroud. Excise the tumor.

items.name: Dark Crystal Cluster
items.description: A cluster of dark crystals, growing together. They reach into different directions like the finger bones of the undead, clawing themselves out of their graves.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Dark Morningstar
items.description: Children rumored that people killed by this Morningstar would have their souls banished inside the orb. These remnants would echo aimlessly forever in their spherical prison, bouncing between the curved walls and the void.

items.name: Dark Staff
items.description: A magical staff, utilizing the power of darkness to cast stronger magic spells. A mighty tool feared by every sorcerer.

items.name: Darkwood Axe
items.description: This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.

items.name: Darya's Staff
items.description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left.

items.name: Darya's Wand
items.description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through.

items.name: Daylilies For Emily
items.description: These warm oranges evoke the smell of daylilies, the warmth of a hearthfire, and the vision of sharing a sunrise with the one you love. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Daylilies For Emily dye can be found at .

items.name: Daylily
items.description: A orange daylily flower. The petals are vibrant enough to be used for dyes.
items.acquisition: Daylily are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin or Daylily Seedling. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Deadeye Boots
items.description: These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.

items.name: Deadeye Gloves
items.description: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.

items.name: Deadeye Hood
items.description: This archery hood lets you watch over the peaks and valleys like a hawk. Nothing will escape your vigilant gaze !

items.name: Deadeye Trousers
items.description: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage !

items.name: Deadeye Vest
items.description: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.

items.name: Death Gazer Axe
items.description: Its crystal eye watches the battlefield, and thoses it fixes upon rarely see another dawn.

items.name: Decay Tool
items.description: A magical tool capable of adding and removing signs of decay to walls in your base.
items.acquisition: Can be crafted from the Collector survivor, found at the end of the Springlands Hollow Halls during .

items.name: Deceit
items.description: At first glance, the muted mauve shrouds the wearer in the mundane. Only a keen eye can spot the deceitful, spiteful green lurking underneath. This color palette can be made with BBB materials.
items.acquisition: The Deceit dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station. The Deceit dye can be found at the .

items.name: Deceiving Staff
items.description: The weapon of choice for the deceitful.

items.name: Decoration Workbench
items.description: Equipped with woodworking and stone masonry tools, this workbench lets you craft beautiful decorative pieces for your home with the Carpenter's help.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked once you find the Carpenter and finding his Masonry Tools

items.name: Decorative Bells I
items.description: Decorative bells especially suitable for the winter season.

items.name: Decorative Bells II
items.description: Decorative bells especially suitable for the winter season.

items.name: Decorative Bells III
items.description: Decorative bells especially suitable for the winter season.

items.name: Decorative Butter Churn
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Decorative Oven I
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Decorative Oven II
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Decorative Oven III
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Deeproot Axe
items.description: Carved from foraged dead wood and dusty roots, this axe was hardened in the sun to tear flesh and split bones.

items.name: Deerstalker Boots
items.description: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.

items.name: Deerstalker Chest
items.description: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.

items.name: Deerstalker Gloves
items.description: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.

items.name: Deerstalker Hood
items.description: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.

items.name: Deerstalker Trousers
items.description: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.

items.name: Desert City Wall
items.description: Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Desert City Wall Block in . It is found in a silver chest on the first floor of Emily Fray's tavern in the center of the Western district of town.

items.name: Desert Shingle Roof Block
items.description: A shingle block in blue hues, used in the angled rooftops of the Kindlewastes.
items.acquisition: This block can be found in . It is found in a silver chest on top of the tallest building on the North side of town.

items.name: Desert Temple Block
items.description: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Desert Temple Block in the . It is found on a skeleton near the Flame Shrine.

items.name: Devilish Bow
items.description: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.

items.name: Diamond Wall Emblem (Maces)
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Diamond Wall Emblem (Swords)
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Dimweald Axe
items.description: A one-handed axe, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Lando, the secondborn. He was loyal to the end.

items.name: Dimweald Hammer
items.description: A mighty hammer, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Berhtolf, the firstborn son. Bravery was his downfall.
items.acquisition: Dimweald Hammer is obtained randomly from Lootable Chests or Bosses in Hollow Halls. C:Datamined Content

items.name: Direction Sign
items.description: A direction sign that you can write on.

items.name: Dirt Road Block
items.description: A simple dirt road material that allows you to decorate your base with natural-looking paths.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Stone for the first time. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

items.name: Diver's Endurance Flask
items.description: A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke.

items.name: Diving Helmet
items.description: A silver helmet that increases your maximum oxygen while diving. Its delicate engraved lines imitate the flow of water, and the viewport is segmented like a clam's shell.

items.name: Dog Bowl
items.description: A little feeding bowl for your Dog.

items.name: Dog Food
items.description: Nutritious Dog food for tame pets.

items.name: Dog Food Bait
items.description: Food for attracting and taming a Dog.

items.name: Dog Pillow
items.description: A soft pillow for your Dog.

items.name: Draconian Bow
items.description: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes, the Draconian Vulture.
items.acquisition: Draconian Bow is a reward from . C:Lore Weapons C:Early Access Launch

items.name: Dragon Sword
items.description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

items.name: Dragon's Wing
items.description: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

items.name: Dragonsbane
items.description: An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton. Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

items.name: Drak Blood
items.description: Violet blood. It runs cold, and the consistency is somewhat syrupy.
items.acquisition: Drak Blood is also a common drop from Drak. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Drak Claws
items.description: Meant to hold and rip prey, these claws are still sharp as ever.
items.acquisition: Drak Claws is also a common drop from Drak. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Drak Relief I
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. You will have to dive into the water will be helpful. After diving in and passing the gold chest there will be a hole to swim further down. The relief is found in this room.

items.name: Drak Relief II
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple, enter underwater from the east end. Upon entering avoid the arrow traps after surfacing and the dead-mans chest. You will have to dive into the water on the right side of the locked door, will be helpful. After diving in pass the door switch and circle around. The relief will be located in a small room with .

items.name: Drak Relief III
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients. The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. First you will have to gain entry by enabling the two switches in the side buildings next to the pool. Once opened Drak will flood out, defeat them and enter the temple under water, will be helpful. Swim through on the left and avoid the spike traps. On the other side swim over some rubble into another room where the relief will be located.

items.name: Drak Relief IV
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside a bathroom on the north west end.

items.name: Drak Relief Showcase
items.description: A showcase that holds pieces of a Drak themed relief. Collect all pieces to complete this showcase and unlock special trophy recipes.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving any of the 7 of the Drak Relief piece.

items.name: Drak Relief V
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon — a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. Descend down until the path splits at the lava and take the right. Following it around you will come to a grapple anchor, glide down south to the platform, then turn around and glide to the other side. Follow through the doorway and you'll see floor spikes on the other end of the hall is the relief.

items.name: Drak Relief VI
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located inside the temple. First you must open the inside door, the switch is in a crawlspace behind a pile of crates. Then you'll be directed through the underwater maze using a number of blue light switches that illuminate green lamps lighting the way. After doing a few switches you'll swim up to a large open room with open air and grating above, the room will have . On the west wall of this room in the water holds this relief.

items.name: Drak Relief VII
items.description: A relief that details the history of the Drak. The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . It is located behind one of the grates blocking in the Snapjaw. The gate opens after hitting the switch to release the water.

items.name: Drak Scales
items.description: Fresh and glistening Drak scales, shimmering and shifting in the golden glow of the sun.
items.acquisition: Drak Scales is also a common drop from Drak. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Drak Soulward Flask
items.description: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them.

items.name: Drak Stone Totem I
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Stone Totem II
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Stone Totem III
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Stone Totem IV
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Stone Totem V
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Teeth
items.description: A collection of conical teeth. The Drak lose them aplenty throughout their lives and fill the more permanent holes with gold implants or rage.
items.acquisition: Drak Teeth is also a common drop from Drak. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Drak Temple Block
items.description: A building block that's commonly used by the Drak, specifically the Drak'Dal.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained in the south of Orville in the Veilwater Basin. Enter the temple from any of the exterior doors and go to the center. Look for the stairs leading downward into water. Swim down the passage way to find a gold chest containing the blocks.

items.name: Drak Temple Roof Block
items.description: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.
items.acquisition: Finding this block is the objective of the quest

items.name: Drak Temple Vase I
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Temple Vase II
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
