items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Temple Vase VI
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Temple Vase VII
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Whistle Bow
items.description: This bow was fashioned after the likeness of the Drak'Dal, even though they don't use such weapons themselves. An arrow shot from this bow will split the air like the sharp whistle of the drakian tongue.

items.name: Drak Wood Totem I
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Wood Totem II
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Wood Totem III
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Wood Totem IV
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak Wood Totem V
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Drak'Dal Spine
items.description: Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.

items.name: Drakian Boots
items.description: A pair of boots that has been reinforced with Drak paraphernalia, granting you the upper hand in combat.

items.name: Drakling Daggers
items.description: These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.

items.name: Draped In Envy
items.description: The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.acquisition: The Draped In Envy dye can be found at the .

items.name: Dreadbane
items.description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!
items.acquisition: Dreadbane is found at the location

items.name: Dried Banana Chips
items.description: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer - and the crunch is nice too.

items.name: Dried Fur
items.description: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.
items.acquisition: Dried Fur is crafted at the Drying Rack. It is also a common physical item in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Dried Purple Berry
items.description: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple berries. However, the duration lasts longer.
items.acquisition: Dried Purple Berry is crafted by the Drying Rack. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world.

items.name: Drying Rack
items.description: Uses salt to conserve furs for further usage. Place near a Hunter.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Hunter during . It is then crafted at the Hunter. However, you need Salt to dry things, so completing will be beneficial.

items.name: Dull Shark Tooth
items.description: A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands. C:Melodies Of The Mire Update

items.name: Dune Armadillo Feeder
items.description: A feeding device that holds Dune Armadillo food.

items.name: Dune Armadillo Food
items.description: Nutritious Dune Armadillo food for tame animals on your farm.

items.name: Dune Armadillo Food Bait
items.description: Food for attracting and taming a Dune Armadillo. To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

items.name: Dusk Amethyst
items.description: A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Dusk Amethyst dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Eagle Eye Boots
items.description: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.

items.name: Eagle Eye Chest
items.description: The bright adornment on this armor piece shines brightly and aims to honor the glorious Flame.

items.name: Eagle Eye Gloves
items.description: Blessed by the Flame and bathed in the glorious light, these gloves will ensure that your every strike is guided by the Ancients themselves.

items.name: Eagle Eye Helmet
items.description: This hood further enhances your sight and lets your gaze burn hotter than a thousand suns.

items.name: Eagle Eye Trousers
items.description: The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.

items.name: Eclipsed Blade
items.description: Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse.

items.name: Ectoplasm
items.description: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.

items.name: Ectoplasm Block
items.description: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Ectoplasm Block in the . It is found in a silver chest on top of a pillar in the middle of the large collapsed chamber.

items.name: Ectoplasm Cluster
items.description: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.
items.acquisition: They can be looted from Hollow in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.

items.name: Ectoplasm Crystal
items.description: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.
items.acquisition: Ectoplasm Crystals can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.

items.name: Ectoplasm Fragment
items.description: A small crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy
items.acquisition: Ectoplasm Fragments can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in the Hollow Halls. Ectoplasm Fragments can also be obtained from green glowing bone piles in the Hollow Halls using the Pickaxe.

items.name: Ectoplasm Gem
items.description: A facetted gemstone made from refined frozen ectoplasm.

items.name: Ectoplasm Press
items.description: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.

items.name: Ectoplasm Shard
items.description: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.
items.acquisition: Ectoplasm Shards can be obtained from defeating Hollow enemies in Hollow Halls, it first appears in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls. fr:Éclat d'ectoplasme

items.name: Ectoplasm Soup
items.description: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.
items.acquisition: Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

items.name: Efflorescent Hope Boots
items.description: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Faedeer hooves.

items.name: Efflorescent Hope Chest
items.description: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing - or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.

items.name: Efflorescent Hope Flower Crown
items.description: A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo. Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.

items.name: Efflorescent Hope Gloves
items.description: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening- a reach toward the light above the water’s surface.

items.name: Efflorescent Hope Pants
items.description: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon

items.name: Eggs
items.description: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.
items.acquisition: Eggs are dropped by several creatures, primarily the Flightless Redtail, starting in the Nomad Highlands. They are also collected from domesticated Flightless Redtail.

items.name: Elder Boots
items.description: The design of these boots imitates the skin of wyverns. Their scales were rumored to have the exceptional ability to absorb magical energy from all around!

items.name: Elder Chest
items.description: This armor was conceived to restrain and control the wearer's smoldering magical energy within. If worn by a mere apprentice rather than an elder, it could make their heart stop!

items.name: Elder Gloves
items.description: All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought - after gloves.

items.name: Elder Hat
items.description: The past, present, and future all unfold in front of your eyes like blooming aureolins when observed through this helmet.

items.name: Elder Trousers
items.description: Magnificent pants, word by the most battle hardened and sagacious wizards.

items.name: Elder's Staff
items.description: A magic staff, brimming with the power of its former owner. Legend has it that the elder's soul is linked to it, sometimes humming at night.

items.name: Electric Nerve
items.description: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.

items.name: Elevated Sea Urchin
items.description: This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Springlands.

items.name: Elite Hollow Boots
items.description: These boots are enhanced with metal plates, providing more defense to the sensitive shins of the skeletons wearing them.

items.name: Elite Hollow Chest Plate
items.description: A combination of rust-red fabric, metal plates, and gold accents. The latter usually matches the Hollow's gold teeth!

items.name: Elite Hollow Gloves
items.description: Heavy gloves, usually carried by bony or rotting ice-cold fingers.

items.name: Elite Hollow Helmet
items.description: An extravagant helmet with red plumes, traditionally worn by high-ranking army commanders.

items.name: Elite Hollow Pants
items.description: Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of died blood on them.

items.name: Elixir
items.description: This Elixir of the Shroud contains great power.... at a cost.
items.acquisition: The Elixir (known as Mysterious Flask) can be picked up as a physical item in Scavenger camps or as a random drop from Scavengers.

items.name: Emberfin
items.description: This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".
items.acquisition: Emberfin can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like , and . C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Emerald Forest
items.description: Lush and lively like the Nomad Highlands flora before the drought. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Emerald Forest dye can be found at the . After obtaining the dye, more can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Empty Flower Pot (Square)
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Enflamed Sword
items.description: A burning sword, glowing with power. It burns hot enough to reduce the mana of its prey with every hit.

items.name: Enhanced Spiked Club
items.description: The most basic weaponry, enhanced to be more effective and durable.
items.acquisition: Enhanced Spiked Club is craftable by the .

items.name: Enormous Magic Chest
items.description: A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

items.name: Enshrouded Axe
items.description: A mighty axe wich lusts for blood.

items.name: Enshrouded Cyclops Eye
items.description: A massive, unblinking eye brimming with Shroud power. Its overwhelming energy is a critical element in crafting exotic high-level armor.
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Fell Cyclops, first found in the Albaneve Summits biome.

items.name: Enshrouded Ice
items.description: Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cool to the touch. It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
items.acquisition: Commonly found in the Shroud of the Albaneve Summits biome.

items.name: Enshrouded Oil
items.description: Its uses are unknown even to the creator itself, but it definitely didn't help the skin of the Fell!

items.name: Enshrouded Vulture Talon
items.description: A massive, razor-sharp talon.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Fell Draconian Vulture, first found in the Kindlewastes biome.

items.name: Epic Fishing Bait
items.description: Bait that increases the chance of catching epic fish.

items.name: Eternal Acid Bite
items.description: Banned in most mystic circles, this spell serves as an infinite well of acid to envenom foes. It's bite is most deadly, so use with care

items.name: Eternal Chain Heal
items.description: An eternal spell which distributes great healing that jumps to nearby friends.

items.name: Eternal Chain Lightning
items.description: An eternal spell which releases a powerful lightning strike that shocks nearby enemies and jumps to others nearby. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
items.acquisition: Eternal Chain Lighting can be crafted with the Alchemist. The recipe unlocks once you obtain Silver Dust for the first time, by grinding down Silver Bars in the Grinding Stone.

items.name: Eternal Fireball
items.description: This spell is fueled by the eternal Flame and serves as unlimited magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a large area. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

items.name: Eternal Fireball II
items.description: Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

items.name: Eternal Frost Arrow I
items.description: An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.

items.name: Eternal Frost Arrow II
items.description: An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.

items.name: Eternal Heal Beam Channel
items.description: Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

items.name: Eternal Heal Channel
items.description: An eternal spell which heals all allies in need.

items.name: Eternal Ice Bolt
items.description: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.

items.name: Eternal Ice Bolt II
items.description: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.

items.name: Eternal Light Burst
items.description: This eternal is imbued with the power of light. When cast, a bright burst of radiance flashes before you and pushes back enemies.

items.name: Eternal Lightning Channel
items.description: Umlimited magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals stamina damage.

items.name: Ethereal Plane
items.description: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

items.name: Evergreen Tree Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Excellent Ectoplasm
items.description: A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".

items.name: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup
items.description: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.
items.acquisition: Excellent Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

items.name: Excellent Fishing Rod
items.description: A fine fishing rod that makes catching as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.
items.acquisition: Can be crafted after starting from the Fisher.

items.name: Exceptional Flute
items.description: A dedicate flute, decorated with swift aquamarine brushstrokes that carry the tones forth like silvery winds.
items.acquisition: Found in the eastern in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Exceptional Hand Drum
items.description: An epic drum with finely painted blue lines on it. The pattern on top resembles a symmetrical star.
items.acquisition: Found in the northern in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Exceptional Handpan
items.description: This golden handpan was used by the Drak. Did they play it during ceremonies, sacrifices, or duels? you can't say for sure, but you do know that its sound is magical and enticing.
items.acquisition: Found in the Veilwater Basin at the .

items.name: Exceptional Harp
items.description: An outstanding harp with fine, silvery strings. The shape of the body and lightweight wood make this instrument perfect for learning to play the strings. Holding it makes you feel a bit melancholic.
items.acquisition: Found on top of a building just North of the tallest tower in

items.name: Exceptional Lute
items.description: A wonderful lute with carefully placed, playful decorative lines. They spring forth like joyful melodies on a sunny summer day.
items.acquisition: Found in the south-eastern in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Exceptional Ring of Health
items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

items.name: Exceptional Ring of Mana
items.description: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

items.name: Exceptional Ring of Stamina
items.description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Boots
items.description: Sturdy boots that withstand any march for hundreds of miles.
items.acquisition: Exclusive Hollow Boots is a Twitch drop-exclusive cosmetic reward.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Chestplate
items.description: This plate armor stands out with its golden glow metal trim and vibrant underlying colorway. The royal purple was achieved by harvesting and heating sea snail mucus in the past, and the extinction of aquatic wildlife only heightens its exclusivity.
items.acquisition: Exclusive Hollow Chestplate is a Twitch drop-exclusive cosmetic reward.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Gloves
items.description: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.
items.acquisition: Exclusive Hollow Gloves is a Twitch drop-exclusive cosmetic reward.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Helmet
items.description: Vibrant amethyst-colored plumes adorn this helmet, indicating that the previous wearer might have been a royal commander.
items.acquisition: Exclusive Hollow Helmet is a Twitch drop-exclusive cosmetic reward.

items.name: Exclusive Hollow Pants
items.description: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.
items.acquisition: Exclusive Hollow Pants is a Twitch drop-exclusive cosmetic reward.

items.name: Executioner's Axe
items.description: An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.

items.name: Experience Scroll
items.description: The most different experiences gathered and described on a scroll. Gain a small amount of experience based upon absorption of the content.

items.name: Explorer Boots
items.description: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

items.name: Explorer Coat
items.description: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

items.name: Explorer Gloves
items.description: Fantastic Gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

items.name: Explorer Helmet
items.description: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

items.name: Explorer Pants
items.description: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

items.name: Explorer's Machete
items.description: A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.

items.name: Explosive Arrow I
items.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise.

items.name: Explosive Arrow II
items.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.

items.name: Explosive Arrow III
items.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.

items.name: Explosive Barrel
items.description: A decorative item for everyone's home.

items.name: Explosive Crawler
items.description: An explosive critter bomb that can be thrown

items.name: Explosive Powder Ball
items.description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

items.name: Explosive Powder Ball Net
items.description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

items.name: Extinguished Sword
items.description: Although no longer enflamed this formerly magical sword still has a sharp edge.

items.name: Extraordinary Glider
items.description: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.

items.name: Fabric
items.description: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.

items.name: Fae Deer Feeder
items.description: A feeding device that holds Fae Deer food.

items.name: Fae Deer Food
items.description: Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

items.name: Fae Deer Food Bait
items.description: Food for attracting and taming a Fae Deer.

items.name: Falk Fall Daggers
items.description: The edge of these daggers is shaped like the break of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies

items.name: Fallen Wing Axe
items.description: Don't be fooled by its name, this axe was forged in defiance and strikes with relentless fury.

items.name: Fancy Stone Block
items.description: A stone block often used for building sturdy soundproof walls.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Fancy Stone Block in . It is found in a silver chest inside the Keep.

items.name: Fang Blade
items.description: This blade is razor-sharp like the fangs of the terrifying creatures that prowl the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Farm Animal Pillow
items.description: A cozy bed for farm animals.

items.name: Farm Soil
items.description: Healthy soil that will increase the growing speed of most plants.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Farmer during . It is then crafted at the Farmer. Farm Soil can also be mined at various locations in the world, particularly Farms.

items.name: Farmer Boots
items.description: Simple boots for hardworking folk.

items.name: Farmer Garb
items.description: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.

items.name: Farmer Hat
items.description: It keeps the sun out of your tired eyes. That's all it has to do!

items.name: Farmer Pants
items.description: Sunbleached pants, carefully patched and sown with leftover thread. The cloth is wearing thin in some areas...

items.name: Fearsome Club
items.description: This club strikes fear into the hearts of your foes with every swing

items.name: Feather
items.description: A feather of a bird or creatures of some kind. Weighing next to nothing, it has to be useful for something.
items.acquisition: Feather is dropped by several creatures starting in the Nomad Highlands. It is also collected from domesticated Round-Billed Sailer, found in the Kindlewastes. FR:Plume

items.name: Feathered Mace
items.description: Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.

items.name: Fell Broad Sword
items.description: A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell.

items.name: Fell Commander Bow
items.description: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Commander Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.

items.name: Fell Confusion Pheromones
items.description: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

items.name: Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic
items.description: Removes Fell Curse upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

items.name: Fell Cyclops Head
items.description: The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.
items.acquisition: Fell Cyclops Head is a drop from Fell Cyclops, encountered in an in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Fell Cyclops Trophy
items.description: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

items.name: Fell Dragon Youngling Head
items.description: Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. the shimmering scales are ice-cold.
items.acquisition: Fell Dragon Youngling Head is a drop from Fell Dragon Younglings, encountered in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
items.description: A lonely soul, brought low by the shroud - and set free by your blade.

items.name: Fell Fashion
items.description: Look lole a Fell Foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Fell Fashion dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Fell Heart
items.description: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Fell Sporehead, first found in the Kindlewastes Shroud.

items.name: Fell Impaler Bow
items.description: Pierce enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Impaler Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.

items.name: Fell Monstrosity Head
items.description: Despair, hatred, loneliness... It grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.
items.acquisition: Fell Monstrosity Head is a drop from Fell Monstrosities, first encountered in the Nomad Highlands Shroud.

items.name: Fell Monstrosity Trophy
items.description: Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter - of sanity and sanctum.

items.name: Fell Shield
items.description: A sturdy shield carried by the Fell. It has held up for ages.

items.name: Fell Sicklescythe Head
items.description: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.
items.acquisition: Fell Sicklescythe Head is a drop from Fell Sicklescythes, encountered in the Kindlewastes Shroud.

items.name: Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
items.description: Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

items.name: Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword
items.description: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword - shrunken for your convenience.

items.name: Fell Thunderbrute Head
items.description: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.
items.acquisition: Fell Thunderbrute Head is a drop from Fell Thunderbrutes, first encountered in the Springlands Shroud.

items.name: Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
items.description: Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

items.name: Fell Wispwyvern Head
items.description: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near Pikemead's Reach, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.
items.acquisition: Fell Wispwyvern Head is a drop from the Fell Wispwyvern encountered at in the Revelwood.

items.name: Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
items.description: The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

items.name: Fenrig's Axe
items.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
items.acquisition: Investigate The Wolf Cave south of Fenrig's Farm || || C:Lore Weapons

items.name: Fern Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Fern Pot (Square)
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Fertile Blackmire Dirt
items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
items.acquisition: Fertile Blackmire Dirt can be found in the Blackmire. Look for more lush patches of grass. There is some at the entrance of the Blackmire Ancient Spire.

items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: An animal, also blessed by the Flame, that spreads light in the dark.
items.acquisition: Fire Flies are harvested in the Springlands at night. They grow a bright yellow and are easily seen from afar.

items.name: Fire Wisp Summon

items.name: Fireball III

items.description: A shiny red brick that is crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.

items.name: Fired Bricks Block
items.description: A block made of Fired Brick. It has a dull red color.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Fired Brick for the first time. Fired Bricks can be crafted by combining Lump of Clay and Wood Logs in the Kiln or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires. Lump of Clay can be found in Revelwood.

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.name: Firefly Wall Lamp
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.name: Fireplaces
items.description: Fireplaces that will provide ample warmth.

items.description: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

items.name: Fish Chowder
items.description: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.

items.name: Fish Cutlet
items.description: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.

items.name: Fish Drying Rack
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Fish Filet
items.description: The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.

items.description: The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendents of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Fish Teeth
items.description: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

items.name: Fish Trophy Board
items.description: A wall-mounted board that lets you display all your fishing achievements.

items.description: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

items.name: Flame Mosaic Piece I
items.description: A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards! This Collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Showcase. The showcase must be placed on a wall.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at . Starting from the lowest entrance of the keep on the east side where the flame checkpoint is head south into the keep. Go to the left of the iron gate blocking the path, avoid traps, and lockpick the double door into the storage room. From here immediately head left and up two flights of stairs. Head straight through the door and you are on the other side of the metal gate. Head south and climb the rubble to get up to the next floor. Continue south up the stairs and head to the right. You'll climb another small set of stairs and avoid floor traps. At the end head right up a few stairs and then left through the hole in the rock. On the other side of the rock head up the stairs on the right and make a double left turn back up to the rock. Follow the path under the wooden archway till you get to a dead end then look up to the right to see a zipline. Zip up and climb the grate to the top. Follow the path around the rock to the left continue to follow the path and jump across scaffolding to get to the top of the rock. The piece is buried in the snow next to the grave.
