items.description: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.

items.name: Flame Pact Gloves
items.description: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down - you'll always look fashionable with these!

items.name: Flame Pact Hat
items.description: A floppy hat with red feathers.

items.name: Flame Pact Pants
items.description: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.

items.name: Flame Pact Vest
items.description: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.

items.name: Flame Shield
items.description: This shield, imbued by the Flame, allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

items.name: Flaming Gauntlets
items.description: Gauntlets that burn with pure, magical fire. Use them to set your foes aflame!
items.acquisition: Flaming Gauntlets is found at Gateway Outpost "Endflame", lore note on the west side next to a repair station will guide you to find this item.

items.name: Flammable Goo
items.description: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!

items.name: Flare Arrow
items.description: Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. The Flare Arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.

items.name: Flask of the Fell
items.description: The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a as part of . It is then crafted by the Alchemist.

items.name: Flat Bread
items.description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

items.name: Flax
items.description: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.
items.acquisition: Flax is obtained from Flax plants, found in the Revelwood biome. Flax can also be grown from Flax Seedlings.

items.name: Flax Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Flax Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Flax for the first time. Flax can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Fleshgrinder
items.description: The needles of this spiked club can tenderize countless meat bags to mush.

items.name: Flint
items.description: A mix of flint and basalt, with a hint of faded lavender. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.acquisition: The Flint dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Flint Arrow
items.description: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.

items.name: Flintstone
items.description: A soft small rock that became famous for its ability to release sparks. It has been associated with the Flame ever since
items.acquisition: Mined from Flintstone veins, found commonly in the Springlands. fr:Pierre de silex

items.name: Floor Drain
items.description: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.

items.name: Flour
items.description: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.

items.name: Flower Snake
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Flower Soil
items.description: The perfect soil for growing beautiful flowers.
items.acquisition: Flower Soil can be found by digging patches of flower-covered ground at .

items.name: Flower Vase
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Flower Wreath
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Fluffy Boots
items.description: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.
items.acquisition: Fluffy Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Fluffy Hood
items.description: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?
items.acquisition: Fluffy Hood is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Fluffy Mittens
items.description: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".
items.acquisition: Fluffy Mittens is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Fluffy Pants
items.description: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.
items.acquisition: Fluffy Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Fluffy Tunic
items.description: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!
items.acquisition: Fluffy Tunic is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Flute
items.description: A flute carved bone. You can use it to make music.

items.name: Foliage
items.description: A leafy green plant material naturally occuring in the Blackmire. It can be used for creating hedge mazes or garden artistry.

items.name: Food Plate
items.description: A wooden plate to display cooked food on a table.

items.name: Fool's Demise
items.description: A voice reverberates through your bone marrow each time you grip the greatsword's handle. "King of fools, hear your fate foretold: Your skull shall shatter, and from within the hollow dome, you will gaze up through eyes rolled inwards at your soul; an incandescent fountain, spouting from the cracks."

items.name: Fool's Errand
items.description: You hear a faint whisper in the back of your head; unified in word, but spoken from a dozen tongues. A ghostly choir pleads with you. "Descending these dungeons is a fool's errand, can't you see? Turn back while you still can."

items.name: Foreboding Golden Urn
items.description: A golden urn with intricate ornaments in the shape of an eerie skull. The lateral detailing resembles fangs or claws.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Forest Beet
items.description: The edible root of a forest plant. Not all that sustaining on its own. Maybe good as an ingredient?
items.acquisition: Forest Beet is obtained from Forest Beet plants, found in the Revelwood biome. Forest Beets can also be grown from Beet Seedlings.

items.name: Forest Longbow
items.description: This bow has great tension, making it exhausting to use. It does greate damage in exchange.

items.name: Forge
items.description: A workplace that will enable new crafting possibilities for the Blacksmith

items.name: Forgotten Library
items.description: The warm and dusty green hues remind you of old leather-bound books with frayed and copper clasps. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Forgotten Library dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Forsaken
items.description: Lost and forgotten amidst the Shroud, this bow unleaches fury on anyone that crosses its path.

items.name: Fossil Showcase (2 Medium Slots)
items.description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
items.acquisition: Fossil Showcase (2 Medium Slots) is crafted by the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining any Fossil to unlock.

items.name: Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots)
items.description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
items.acquisition: Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots) is crafted by the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining any Fossil to unlock.

items.name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots)
items.description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
items.acquisition: Fossil Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots) is crafted by the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining any Fossil to unlock.

items.name: Fossil Showcase (3 Small Slots)
items.description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
items.acquisition: Fossil Showcase (3 Small Slots) is crafted by the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires obtaining any Fossil to unlock.

items.name: Fossilized Bone
items.description: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availability and high magical capacity.
items.acquisition: Mined from giant bones found in the Nomad Highlands and the Kindlewastes. An easily accessible giant fossilized rib cage is located west of the .

items.name: Fossilized Bone Arrow
items.description: An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.

items.name: Fossilized Bone Dust
items.description: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.

items.name: Fowler Boots
items.description: Wearing these boots makes each step feel like you're being carried on silver wings

items.name: Fowler Chest
items.description: The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.

items.name: Fowler Gloves
items.description: These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds out of the sky ! There are hardly any birds these days, though.

items.name: Fowler Helmet
items.description: Remain keen - eyed as a hawk with this eerie hood.

items.name: Fowler Trousers
items.description: Green pants which allow the wearer to glide through tall grass swiftly and silently.

items.name: Fresh Shroud Spore
items.description: Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.
items.acquisition: Collected from glowing blue mushrooms surrounded by groups of Fell, found at night throughout Embervale.

items.name: Freshblood Mace
items.description: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth this process is represented through the design of this mace.

items.name: Fried Rice
items.description: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!

items.name: Frizzy Goat Milk
items.description: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance.

items.name: Frog
items.description: A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fishbait. Found in the Veilwater Basin and especially helpful to catch epic fish.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Veilwater Basin C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Frog In The Grass
items.description: Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Frog In The Grass dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: From Dusk Till Dawn
items.description: Through the dark night until dawn drapes the ski in golden - yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too! This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The From Dusk Till Dawn dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Frost Smasher
items.description: Every aspect of this hammer's head is designed meticulously. The front and back boast a colorful yet distinguished design, while the sides share a row of spikes. Appealing, and functional.

items.name: Frost Wand
items.description: A wand that focuses a wielder's power through a frozen crystal. Magical energy is refracted inside and amplified with every reflection.

items.name: Frostbite Slasher Boots
items.description: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

items.name: Frostbite Slasher Chest
items.description: A breezy west layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

items.name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves
items.description: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

items.name: Frostbite Slasher Hood
items.description: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

items.name: Frostbite Slasher Trousers
items.description: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

items.name: Frostwing Axe
items.description: Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow. Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.

items.name: Frozen Core Wand
items.description: This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes.

items.name: Frozen Gauntlets
items.description: A pair of gauntlets that are as cold as snow on a sunless eve. Use them to freeze the hearts of your enemies!
items.acquisition: You'll find the lore note in a building in the center of on the second floor, that will guide you to find the Frozen Gauntlets located at the bottom of Lacemaker Pond from a corpse. You will need armor with Frost Resistance to reach the corpse.

items.name: Fruit Bowl
items.description: A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

items.name: Fur Boots
items.description: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.

items.name: Fur Chest
items.description: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.

items.name: Fur Gloves
items.description: Simple but reliable protection for hands.

items.name: Fur Hood
items.description: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.

items.name: Fur Patch
items.description: A small shred of animal fur
items.acquisition: Fur Patch is a common drop from small wildlife such as Rats and Bats, found throughout Embervale. fr:Écusson de fourrure

items.name: Fur Rug
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Fur Trousers
items.description: A little archaic, but better than cloth.

items.name: Furry straw mat
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Gastropods
items.description: These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Gem of Aerobatics
items.description: Attacking while in the air spawns +6 projectiles that home towards your target and deal 17 piercing damage.

items.name: Gem of Agility
items.description: After performing an evade action, the next hit deals X additional cutting damage and replenishes X stamina on the next hit.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Banshee in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Gem of Battle Mania
items.description: While the Elixir Buff is active, dealing damage activates the "Satisfied Battle Mania" buff, granting X health, X stamina, and X mana regeneration for X. Each additional hit refreshes the duration of that buff; however, once it runs out, the "Unsatisfied Battle Mania" debuff will suspend any health, stamina, and mana regeneration for X.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Scavenger Berserker and Vukah Berserker in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Gem of Bleeding
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Banshee in the Springlands. It is a guaranteed drop from the in the Springlands.

items.name: Gem of Bloodlust
items.description: Grants a X base chance to spawn a health orb when defeating an enemy. Collecting a health orb grants X additional cutting damage to attacks and increases the chance for health orbs by X for X.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper and Vukah Berserker in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Gem of Cold Composure
items.description: Blocking or aiming for a short time grants X physical and X magical resistance, but slows the movement by X. Getting hit or attacking while buffed creates an ice explosion that deals X ice damage and slows enemies, after which the buff gets removed.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Banshee in the Nomad Highlands and Fell Commander in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Gem of Corruption
items.description: Hitting an enemy applies a mark that can stack up to 5 times. Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of mark has been added for X or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals X Shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0.5m and X of the base damage to the explosion.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Banshee in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Gem of Currents
items.description: While Wet or Soaked, damaging enemies will apply Soaked to them for X sec. Damaging soaked enemies has a chance of X to deal X bonus Shock Damage.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Drak in the Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Gem of Focused Light
items.description: Targeting an enemy for a few seconds while aiming or blocking puts a mark on the enemy. Attacking the marked enemy deals X additional fire damage. The mark can stack up to 3 times by continued targeting, increasing the bonus damage by X at 2 stacks and X at 3 stacks.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Commander and Scavenger Berserker in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Gem of Fracturing
items.description: Killing an enemy with blunt damage has a X chance to create homing bone shards that deal X blunt damage, with a chance of spawning up to 4 projectiles.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.

items.name: Gem of Hopeful Embers
items.description: When the remaining time in the Shroud is below X, defeated enemies drop time replenishing Orbs.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Fell Banshee in the Revelwood.

items.name: Gem of Lesser Necromancy
items.description: Killing an enemy with no allied unarmored Hollow active has a chance to spawn an allied level X unarmored Hollow.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.

items.name: Gem of Lycanthropy
items.description: X

items.name: Gem of Meteoric Impact
items.description: Landing after gliding creates an explosion that deals X fire damage and leaves behind a trail of fire that applies burning to enemies, dealing X damage per second for X. After the initial impact, attacks deal X additional fire damage for X.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper and Vukah Berserker in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Gem of Necromancy
items.description: Killing an enemy with no allied armored Hollow active has a chance to spawn an allied level X armored Hollow.
items.acquisition: Currently, it is not normally obtained on the game.

items.name: Gem of Overpowering
items.description: Attacking a blocking enemy deals X additional stamina damage and increased pushback.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Vukah Berserker, Scavenger Berserker, Hollow Reaper and Shroud Stalker in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Gem of Puncturing
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Scavenger Berserker in the Nomad Highlands. A guaranteed drop of this Gem can be looted by the Scavenger Berserker at , in the Springlands.

items.name: Gem of Retaliation
items.description: Blocking damage has a X chance to add X bonus blunt damage to the next attack within the next few seconds and increases the pushback.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Vukah Berserker or Scavenger Matron in the Revelwood.

items.name: Gem of Skulls
items.description: Killing an enemy with a visceral attack has a % chance to spawn a level X companion skull.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper in the Springlands Hollow Halls.

items.name: Gem of Soul Reaping
items.description: Damaging an enemy puts a mark on them for X. Marked enemies spawn a soul phial on death that can be destroyed to heal you and your allies for X in a 5m radius and also counts as an enemy kill for other effects.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Hollow Reaper in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls.

items.name: Gem of Storm's Eye
items.description: Hitting an enemy puts a mark on them for X. Hitting a marked enemy sends a lightning bolt to another marked enemy, dealing X damage. The attack can chain to more marked enemies. After lightning triggers, the effect has a X cooldown before it can retrigger from the same enemy. After the cooldown, the mark is refreshed.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Vukah Berserker, Fell Commander and Shroud Stalker in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Gem of Swiftness
items.description: After sprinting for a short time, attacks deal X bonus cutting damage for X. The duration refreshes every time damage is dealt.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Scavenger Berserker and Hollow Reaper in the Revelwood.

items.name: Gem of Toxic Betrayal
items.description: Landing a backstab on an enemy applies poison for X that deals X poison damage per second.
items.acquisition: This Gem is dropped by Scavenger Berserker in the Revelwood.

items.name: Gemini Ring
items.description: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini-- quivering with hatred in the moonlight.

items.name: Gentian
items.description: A star-shaped blossom that blooms in the high-up mountains. It grants more spirit when consumed.

items.name: Gentian Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Gentian Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Gentian for the first time. Gentian can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Ghost Glider
items.description: A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.

items.name: Ghostly Shield
items.description: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a as part of . It is then crafted by the Blacksmith if the Forge have been placed.

items.name: Giant Bone Arrow
items.description: An arrow made from giant bone.

items.name: Giant Bones
items.description: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.
items.acquisition: Giant Bones are looted from Hollow Cyclops bosses found in the , , and . Each Hollow Cyclops drops 4-8 bones.

items.name: Giant Critter Scales
items.description: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Fell Critter Queen, first found in the Revelwood biome.

items.name: Giant Hollow Halls Banner
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Gilded Axe
items.description: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.

items.name: Gilded Pickaxe
items.description: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.

items.name: Ginger
items.description: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.

items.name: Ginger In A Jungle
items.description: Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Ginger In A Jungle dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Ginger Plant Pot
items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home

items.name: Ginger Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed when harvesting Ginger for the first time, which can be found in Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Ginger Tea
items.description: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.

items.name: Glass
items.description: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!

items.name: Glass Shards
items.description: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.
items.acquisition: Found as a physical item in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Gleam Root
items.description: An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the seafloor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.
items.acquisition: Gleam Root are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin at night underwater. The plant grows blue and is easily seen from afar.

items.name: Gleam Root Diving Light
items.description: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.

items.name: Gleam Root Dust
items.description: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Gleaming Staff
items.description: A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks.

items.name: Glider
items.description: The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait.

items.name: Glimmer Gentian
items.description: "Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night. It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Albaneve Summits at night, it grows a bright purple color and is easily seen from afar.

items.name: Glimmer Gentian Tea
items.description: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.

items.name: Gloom Monarch Boots
items.description: These boots seemingly once belonged to a ruler who's name has been lost to time. It faded into oblivion, leaving only a title and lingering curse.

items.name: Gloom Monarch Chestplate
items.description: A fearsome chest piece. It's rumored to have belonged to a fallen warrior whose name is never spoken out loud.

items.name: Gloom Monarch Gloves
items.description: Legends say that these gloves once belonged to a dark ruler whose name has been wiped from the history books.

items.name: Gloom Monarch Helmet
items.description: It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.

items.name: Gloom Monarch Trousers
items.description: This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.

items.name: Gloomberry
items.description: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue pigments.
items.acquisition: Gloomberry is harvested from plants in the Revelwood at night. The plant grows a bright blue and is easily seen from afar.

items.name: Glow Dust
items.description: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.

items.name: Glow Soup
items.description: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked after crafting spice in the laboratory after obtaining the almanac of Plants and Seedlings.

items.name: Goat Feeder
items.description: A feeding device that holds Goat food.

items.name: Goat Food
items.description: Nutritious Goat food for tame animals on your farm.

items.name: Goat Food Bait
items.description: Food for attracting and taming a Goat.

items.name: Goat Hammer
items.description: A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected.

items.name: Gold Bars
items.description: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

items.name: Gold Coins
items.description: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.
items.acquisition: Gold Coins can be found in the Veilwater Basin, the Carpenter sends you on the quest however, you can collect Gold Coins prior to that out in the world. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Gold Cyclops Trophy
items.description: Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

items.name: Gold Dust
items.description: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

items.name: Gold Fell Cyclops Trophy
items.description: There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

items.name: Gold Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy
items.description: As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

items.name: Gold Fell Monstrosity Trophy
items.description: Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

items.name: Gold Fell Sicklescythe Trophy
items.description: The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

items.name: Gold Fell Thunderbrute Trophy
items.description: Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

items.name: Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy
items.description: Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

items.name: Gold Hollow Cyclops Trophy
items.description: The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

items.name: Gold Hydrak'Dal Trophy
items.description: This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.

items.name: Gold In The Water
items.description: Want to look like a gold nuggest resting on the bottom of a lake? With this color palatte, you embody just that - rich, vibrant blues with a hint of sparkling gold. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Gold In The Water dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the wave's don't
items.acquisition: C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Gold Scavenger Matron Trophy
items.description: Completely gilded, you can no longer notice the dirt and stench, so you can hang it in your living room without hesitation.

items.name: Gold Vukah Brawler Trophy
items.description: Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

items.name: Golden Ball
items.description: This palette presents a multitude of yellow tones, vibrant as a polished golden ball or crown carried by a princess. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Golden Ball dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station after being found/unlocked at

items.name: Golden Bulwark Boots
items.description: You've likely never work foot armor this light, but give it a shot - the chest plate's weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Chest Plate
items.description: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing - piercing it would be no easy task.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Gloves
items.description: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Helmet
items.description: Just one look into these eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Pants
items.description: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.

items.name: Golden Bulwark Shield
items.description: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

items.name: Golden Leaf
items.description: Green and brown with a hint of gold, like raining leaves on a slow day in fall. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Golden Leaf dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Golden Recruit Axe
items.description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

items.name: Golden Steel Arrow
items.description: A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.

items.name: Golden War Hero Axe
items.description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

items.name: Goldlaced Greatsword
items.description: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterned edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.

items.name: Gorestriker
items.description: A deadly club that will decimate any enemy.

items.name: Gormander's War Banner I
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Gormander's War Banner II
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Granite
items.description: A magmatic deep rock mostly consisting of feldspar, quartz, and mica.
items.acquisition: Granite is found all over the mountainside in Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Granite Block
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Granite for the first time. Granite can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Granite Fireplace
items.description: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home.

items.name: Granite Ornamented Roof Block
items.description: You can fashion a beautifully detailed, dark roof with this granite roof block.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Silver Bars for the first time.

items.name: Granite Rubble Road Block
items.description: A road material for building rocky mountain roads.
items.acquisition: Can be obtained by mining any granite rubble road found in the Albaneve Summits with a pickaxe. Crafting the block from the more easily obtainable granite is a simpler method, as the recipe is a 1-to-1 ratio of blocks used to blocks created.

items.name: Granite Shingle Roof Block
items.description: These granite shingles bring a mountain flair to your cozy homestead.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Granite for the first time. Granite can be found in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Granite Stone Bathtub
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Granite Stone Lavatory
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Granite Stone Shower
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Granite Stone Sink
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Granite Throne
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Granite Window Frame
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Grapple Plant
items.description: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.
items.acquisition: Grapple Plant is obtained from Grapple Plants, found in the Kindlewastes biome. Large amounts can be found at and . Grapple Plant can also be grown from Grapple Plant Seedlings.

items.name: Grapple Plant Flower Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Grapple Plant Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Grapple Plant for the first time. Grapple Plant can be found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.description: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining (looted from defeated Fell enemies) for the first time. It is then crafted at the Workbench. Crafting a Grappling Hook is the objective of the Blacksmith quest .

items.name: Grappling Hook Pull Anchor
items.description: Add this pull anchor to your buildings to pull yourself forward and onto other platforms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

items.name: Grappling Hook Swing Anchor
items.description: Add this swing anchor to your buildings to swing across chasms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

items.name: Grass Pot (Square)
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Grasshopper
items.description: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Nomad Highlands. Can be found at night. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Gravedigger Boots
items.description: Perfect for wading through ash and moldy earth.

items.name: Gravedigger Garb
items.description: These clothes smell of decay.

items.name: Gravedigger Hat
items.description: People don't make eye contact with gravediggers because it brings bad luck. Therefore, some graveyard keepers wear a cap that covers their eyes to avoid trouble.

items.name: Gravedigger Pants
items.description: There's some extra space in the pockets for storing crypt keys, "borrowed" rings, and lost fingerbones.

items.name: Graven Idol Axe
items.description: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.

items.name: Graveyard Fence
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Graveyard Fence Broken I
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Graveyard Fence Broken II
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Graveyard Fence Pole
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Great Mace
items.description: Easy to use and quite deadly. The sharp blades on the side allow for easier penetration of armor.

items.name: Greater Antidote
items.description: An improved antidote that will cure poison and negate the next poisoning.

items.name: Greater Ectoplasm
items.description: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered an is technically sterile.

items.name: Greater Ectoplasm Soup
items.description: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.
items.acquisition: Greater Ectoplasm Soup is crafted by the Collector

items.name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
items.description: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gasping maw of a cave.
items.acquisition: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword is located at .

items.name: Greater Health Potion
items.description: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining a as part of . It is then crafted by the Alchemist.

items.name: Greater Health Potion +
items.description: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

items.name: Greater Mana Potion
items.description: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.

items.name: Greater Mana Potion +
items.description: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

items.name: Greater Ring of Health
items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

items.name: Greater Ring of Mana
items.description: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

items.name: Greater Ring of Stamina
items.description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

items.name: Greater Shroud Survival Flask
items.description: Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user. Extends the Maximum time in the shroud after consumption by 4 Minutes. This effect will last for 45 Minutes.

items.name: Greater Skull Summoning Vessel
items.description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted by the Collector.

items.name: Greater Thunderblast Axe
items.description: An electrically charged, two-handed axe, able to release sparks into the overcast sky when striking. It was struck by lightning while inside a cataclysmic typhoon and survived, unlike its previous owner.

items.name: Greatsword Gauntlets
items.description: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.
items.acquisition: Greatsword Gauntlets is looted from a chest in the Inn, you'll find the lore note on the first floor and the chest containing the gauntlets at the top floor.

items.name: Greatsword Of Rivalry
items.description: Ace your enemy, one on one, and prove your domination once and for all.

items.name: Greatsword Of The Old Order
items.description: Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your fighteous strikes.

items.name: Green Decorative Box
items.description: A decoratively wrapped present box.

items.name: Green Fabric
items.description: The color of life - a wonderful color for clothes.

items.name: Green Luminescent Block
items.description: A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Purified Slime for the first time. Purified Slime can be crafted by combining Charcoal, Salt, Toxic Slime, and Wood Acid in the Ectoplasm Press. Toxic Slime can be obtained by mining the green deadly waste inside of Hollow Halls.

items.name: Green Rocket
items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

items.name: Green Vitriol Dust
items.description: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.

items.name: Green-Winged Orchid
items.description: This color palette's combination of light green and vibrant purple takes inspiration from extinct orchids. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Green-Winged Orchid dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Grey Blades
items.description: A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy.

items.name: Grilled Algae Buds
items.description: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!

items.name: Grilled Bird Meat
items.description: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect..

items.name: Grilled Crab Meat
items.description: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!

items.name: Grilled Crimsonback
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Dune Armadillo
items.description: A specialty of the Kindlewastes - customers love it because of its health benefits!

items.name: Grilled Emberfin
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Fatty Meat
items.description: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!

items.name: Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice
items.description: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!

items.name: Grilled Game
items.description: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.

items.name: Grilled Lakehopper
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Lean Meat
items.description: Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack. Increases the Constitution of the user by a small margin.

items.name: Grilled Penny Bun
items.description: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.

items.name: Grilled Shadowtail
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Shimmerfin
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Shockfin
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Silverback
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Stripetail
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Sunscale
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Thornridge
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Waveleaper
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Whiskerfin
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Wolf Meat
items.description: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, granting a good amount of Constitution to the consumer.
items.acquisition: Obtained from by manually cooking it at a fireplace, or by using a Cooking Station.

items.name: Grilled Yellowfin
items.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

items.name: Grilled Yucca Fruit
items.description: When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.

items.name: Grinding Stones
items.description: A simple setup for basic grinding work. Especially good for hard ingredients.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted at the Alchemist.

items.name: Ground Coffee Beans
items.description: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!

items.name: Ground Lantern I
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

items.name: Ground Lantern II
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

items.name: Ground Sign
items.description: A standing sign that you can write on.

items.name: Guard of the North Boots
items.description: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Cold Heights under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord Vorgoth finally reached the gates of Pikemead's Reach, weapon raised high.

items.name: Guard of the North Chestplate
items.description: Untouched by the Flame, and veiled in a lingering cold. This armor used to belong to Lord Vorgroth, who was rumored to have a frozen heart that splinters and breaks with every tired beat.

items.name: Guard of the North Gloves
items.description: Wearing these gloves, the Northern Lord carved his way through the enshrouded valleys of Embervale. The scars he cut into people and soil can be traced from Cold Heights's bleak mountains to today's ruins of Pikemead's Reach.

items.name: Guard of the North Helmet
items.description: Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping Vorgoth from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.

items.name: Guard of the North Pants
items.description: Pants that were formerly worn by soldiers of Lord Vorgoth, oldest son to Queen Pikemead. Legends say he was consumed by the Shroud after the Ancients pushed him off Howling Pike's summit.

items.name: Guard Of The North Sword
items.description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting of vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

items.name: Guardian Boots
items.description: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.

items.name: Guardian Chestplate
items.description: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.

items.name: Guardian Gloves
items.description: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.description: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.

items.name: Guardian Shield
items.description: It's more than a shield - it's a bulwark of faith, a final sanctuary in the fray.

items.name: Guardian Trousers
items.description: Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.

items.name: Guillotine
items.description: Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.

items.name: Hailcaster Boots
items.description: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

items.name: Hailcaster Chest
items.description: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.

items.name: Hailcaster Gloves
items.description: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.

items.name: Hailcaster Hat
items.description: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.

items.name: Hailcaster Pants
items.description: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.

items.name: Hailscourge
items.description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
items.acquisition: Hailscourge is located in the cemetery of .

items.name: Hair Splitter
items.description: This axe is eerily percise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.

items.name: Half Wooden Barrel
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Half-Light Halos
items.description: Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light.

items.name: Half-Timbered Block
items.description: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.
items.acquisition: After visiting and talking to the Cade Hawthorn with the "Building Diadwyn" option, a hint is added in the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Half-Timbered Block in . It is found in a silver chest in the middle of the town.

items.name: Half-timbered Shell Limestone Block
items.description: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.

items.name: Hammer Of The Piercing Gaze
items.description: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.

items.name: Hand Drum
items.description: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.

items.name: Hand Spindle
items.description: An item used by the Hunter to create better strings.
items.acquisition: The Hand Spindle is picked up at the in the Revelwood during . Additional Hand Spindles can be crafted at the Hunter after the quest, though the necessary ingredients are not available until reaching the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Handpan
items.description: A hang drum is a hand-played steel instrument whose gentle tones spread like ripples across still water.
items.acquisition: The Handpan is crafted at the Bard. Recipe unlock (unconfirmed).

items.name: Hanfu Ponytail Wig Head
items.description: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.
items.acquisition: The Hanfu Ponytail Wig Head can be found in Brittlebush.

items.name: Hanging Lantern
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

items.name: Hanging Silver Chandelier
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Hardened Leather
items.description: This patch of leather has been made more sturdy and enduring.

items.name: Hardwood
items.description: This especially tough wood could cause much damage if it hits your head while you fell trees.
items.acquisition: Hardwood are obtained from chopping down large trees in the Revelwood biome. fr:Bois dur

items.name: Harp
items.description: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.

items.name: Harrow
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Harvest Festival
items.description: A collection of bright oranges that exhibit a warm and inviting glow. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Harvest Festival dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station after being found/unlocked at .

items.name: Hatchet
items.description: A versatile one handed axe. Frequently used to split the skulls of enemies.

items.name: Hawk Boots
items.description: Ride as swift as the bluejays with these sturdy leather boots.

items.name: Hawk Chest
items.description: A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines and petals

items.name: Hawk Gloves
items.description: Reliable gloves which shield the wearer's arms from claws.

items.name: Hawk Helmet
items.description: This hood includes an iron facemask which was greatly inspired by owls.

items.name: Hawk Trousers
items.description: Pants such as these were originally made fashionable by prominent falconers from ages long past.

items.name: Hazelnut
items.description: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.
items.acquisition: Hazelnut is harvested from Hazelnut bushes, found in the Revelwood biome. Each bush yields multiple hazelnuts. Hazelnut bushes can also be grown from Hazelnut Bush Seedlings.

items.name: Hazelnut Bush Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Hazelnut for the first time. Hazelnut can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Head Pounder
items.description: A gigantic hammer that can only be wielded with both hands. The head was forged from one solid block of steel, requiring advanced crafting techniques.

items.name: Headscarf
items.description: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.
items.acquisition: Headscarf is a unique drop that can be found in .

items.name: Heal Beam Channel
items.description: Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away.

items.name: Heal Channel
items.description: Magical ammunition that, upon use, releasing continuous healing projectiles.

items.name: Healer Boots
items.description: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.

items.name: Healer Gloves
items.description: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds in a pinch.

items.name: Healer Headwrap
items.description: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.

items.name: Healer Pants
items.description: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.

items.name: Healer Tunic
items.description: A breathable tunic with ample space for bandages, herbs, and tissues.

items.name: Health Potion
items.description: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.
items.acquisition: Health Potion is crafted by the Alchemist. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world or looted from chests.

items.name: Health Potion +
items.description: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
items.acquisition: Health Potion + is crafted by the Alchemist. The crafting recipe requires obtaining to unlock.

items.name: Heart Pillow
items.description: A soft velvet heart-shaped pillow, bringing not only comfort but a luxurious, elegant look to any space.
items.acquisition: It can be crafted at the Bard.

items.name: Heart's Desire
items.description: Burning reds, crimson as a passionate kiss - or the blood of a weeping heart, pierced by a lance This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Heart's Desire dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station after being found/unlocked at

items.name: Heather Flower Pot
items.description: A potted plant to beautify your home

items.name: Helix
items.description: A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer.

items.name: Hemotoxin Antidote
items.description: Removes Hemotoxin debuff upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.

items.name: Herbal Mountain Tea
items.description: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.

items.name: Herbalist Boots
items.description: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots !

items.name: Herbalist Gloves
items.description: These fingerless gloves allow the weaver to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.

items.name: Herbalist Headwrap
items.description: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is suprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.

items.name: Herbalist Pants
items.description: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.

items.name: Herbalist Tunic
items.description: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.

items.name: Hero's Shield
items.description: This basic shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

items.name: High Bamboo Window
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: High Carved Wooden Window Frame
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Highly Polished Stone Block
items.description: A stone block refined with the highest level of craftsmanship, rarely seen even in ancient times.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by killing and looting the Scavenger Matron in , which is north-east of the Kindlewastes Ancient Spire.

items.name: Hollow Cyclops Head
items.description: Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.

items.name: Hollow Cyclops Trophy
items.description: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!

items.name: Hollow Halls Block
items.description: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Hollow Halls Block in the . It is found in multiple silver chests in the rooms on the sides of the hall shortly before the Collector.

items.name: Hollow Halls Showcase (1 Large Slot)
items.description: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls

items.description: Magical ammunition that releases a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster.

items.name: Lightforged Axe
items.description: An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.

items.name: Lightforged Daggers
items.description: Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage

items.name: Lightning Channel
items.description: Magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals stamina damage.

items.name: Lilac Insomnia
items.description: The cold thrill of the night winds is far too electrifying to sleep. This color palette is bursting with a trance-like energy and tinged with madnesss. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Lilac Insomnia dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Limestone
items.description: The best stories start small, for example with this stone.
items.acquisition: Mined from cliffs and rock formations throughout the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Limestone Block
items.description: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Limestone Block in . It is found in a silver chest at the top of the old watchtower on the east side of town.

items.name: Limestone Fence
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Limestone Road Block
items.description: A road material made from limestone. It is much lighter and warmer-toned than similar road materials.
items.acquisition: Can be easily obtained by digging out the limestone roads.

items.name: Linen
items.description: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax.
items.acquisition: Linen is crafted at either the Hand Spindle, the Spinning Wheel, or the Spinning Machine. The Hand Spindle produces 6 Linen per minute, making it the fastest but most Flax-intensive. The Spinning Wheel is the slowest at 2 Linen per minute, but uses half as much Flax per Linen as the Hand Spindle. The Spinning Machine balances speed and efficiency, averaging 3.75 Linen per minute and using 50% less Flax per Linen than the Spinning Wheel, though it produces in batches.

items.name: Liquid Light
items.description: Like morning sun, reflected in the still water of an ivory bowl. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Liquid Light dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Lumberer Boots
items.description: Sturdy boots for gathering wood. They're lined with fur, ideal for the summers.
items.acquisition: Lumberer Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the . It is located in the same silver chest along with the Lumberer Pants. The chest is located at the bottom of the large house in the shroud. There will be a shroud jump pad and 4 rail tracks leading outside. Follow the rail track north past the two Shroud Flayers. The chest will be on the other side of a wooden gate that you can break down.

items.name: Lumberer Coat
items.description: A heavy tunic with fur lining
items.acquisition: Lumberer Coat is a unique drop that can be found in the . It is located in a silver chest that can be found on the ground level of the large building. There is a locked door that you can lockpick just to the right of the hearth as you walk in.

items.name: Lumberer Gloves
items.description: Worn-out gloves with sun spots and a fur trim.
items.acquisition: Lumberer Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the . It is located in the same silver chest along with the Lumberer Hat. The chest is located at the large house on the second subfloor with stone flooring just above the shroud.

items.name: Lumberer Hat
items.description: A hat that is made both practical and fun with added fluffy fur.
items.acquisition: Lumberer Hat is a unique drop that can be found in the . It is located in the same silver chest along with the Lumberer Gloves. The chest is located at the large house on the second subfloor with stone flooring just above the shroud.

items.description: Ordinary leather pants.

The chest will be on the other side of a wooden gate that you can break down.

items.name: Lumenshade Axe
items.description: An axe to end any battle quickly.

items.name: Luminous Growth
items.description: It glows in the dark. A moody light source often found in or around caves.

items.name: Luminous Wand
items.description: This wand grants power over fire to whoever is brave enough to wield it.

items.name: Lump of Clay
items.description: A malleable material that is especially useful for construction purposes.
items.acquisition: Lumps of Clay can be mined from clay deposits, commonly found in the Revelwood. Clay deposits look like large clumps of orange-brown mud. fr:Tas d'argile

items.name: Lunar New Year Door
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Lunar New Year Trader during . It is then crafted at the Lunar New Year Trader.

items.name: Lupa's Scalper
items.description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow -- Lupa" is etched on the side.
items.acquisition: Lupa's Scalper can be found on a corpse in . C:Lore Weapons

items.name: Lute
items.description: Lutes are classic instrument of choice for bards. They can be used to play beautiful melodies with friends or alone.

items.name: Lying Wooden Barrel
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Mace of Denial
items.description: It was customary in the far North to carry the dead to their graves while brandishing a steel mace. This presentation of stalwart strength in the face of death and terror would ward off evil spirits and guide the dead safely to the Northwinds of the afterlife.

items.name: Mace of Wrath
items.description: In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and to weed out the weak.

items.name: Mace-like Club
items.description: Don't let the image deceive you. It might look like a mace, but it's a primitive club after all.
items.acquisition: Mace-like Club is craftable by the .

items.name: Madly Maroon
items.description: The color of red wine, dried blood, and broken promises. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Madly Maroon dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Mae's Map Piece
items.description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
items.acquisition: Mae's Map Piece is found at .

items.name: Mage Boots
items.description: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.

items.name: Mage Chest
items.description: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

items.name: Mage Gloves
items.description: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.

items.name: Mage Hat
items.description: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.

items.name: Mage Trousers
items.description: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.

items.name: Magic Shield
items.description: Create a magical barrier that protects from projectiles and reduces melee damage taken.

items.description: Low - cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting !

items.description: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.

items.description: A magician's gloves, bound by a magic - infused golden thread.

items.description: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.

items.name: Magician Trousers
items.description: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.

items.description: Archaic power sleeps within this blade. It resonates, whispers and sings to those who dare to listen.

items.name: Makeshift Daggers
items.description: A long pair of daggers with cloth around the handle.

items.description: Created with mana-potent ingredients, the Mana Potion restores a good amount of mana.
items.acquisition: Mana Potion is crafted by the Alchemist. The crafting recipe requires obtaining a during to unlock. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world or looted from chests.

items.name: Mana Potion +
items.description: Instantly restores a small amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

items.description: Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust.
items.acquisition: Mandible Crusher is obtained randomly from Lootable Chests or Bosses in Hollow Halls.

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

items.name: Marksman Hood
items.description: A darkened hood which lets you blend into the woodland scenery more easily. A piece of red cloth covers the mouth, making you feel like a bandit.

items.name: Marksman Trousers
items.description: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.

items.name: Meat and Mushroom Skewer
items.description: It's a simple combination — a mushroom and some meat on a skewer — but the flavor and the effects go a long way.

items.name: Meat and Tomato Skewer
items.description: Even in the simplest setting, this skewer comes together easily with meat, a tomato, and a small flame.

items.name: Meat Chopper
items.description: A primitively crafted but brutal weapon, awaiting its next prey.

items.name: Meat Wrap
items.description: Filled with the power of life, this wrap will increase the Health of the consumer.
