items.name: Megalodon Greatsword
items.description: You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?

items.name: Mercenary Boots
items.description: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down !

items.name: Mercenary Chest
items.description: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.

items.name: Mercenary Gloves
items.description: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.

items.name: Mercenary Helmet
items.description: This sturdy Mercenary Helmet protects your eyes and hides your expression, making you appear fearless and intimidating.

items.name: Mercenary Shield
items.description: A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.

items.name: Mercenary Trousers
items.description: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.

items.name: Metal Block
items.description: A simple Metal Block. Despite the sleek design, it's quite uncommon as building material.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Metal Sheets for the first time. Metal Sheets can be crafted by combining Metal Scraps and Charcoal in the Forge or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible containers in the Ancient Spires.

items.name: Metal Bound Wooden Door
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Metal Bound Wooden Double Door
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Metal Scraps
items.description: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.
items.acquisition: Metal Scraps are common drops from Scavengers. It can also be looted from destroyed metal objects or picked up as a physical item in the world. The Scavengers around are a good source in the early game. fr:Ferraille

items.name: Metal Sheets
items.description: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.
items.acquisition: Metal Sheets can be crafted at the Forge, which can be created at the Blacksmith.

items.name: Metalstar Mace
items.description: A six-edge mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.

items.name: Midnight Lily
items.description: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.
items.acquisition: Midnight Lily is harvested from plants in the Springlands at night. The plant grows a bright blue and is easily seen from afar.

items.name: Midnight Tomb Block
items.description: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.
items.acquisition: This block is found in an unmarked tomb east of .

items.name: Milk
items.description: A delicious jug of milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance and recharge your stamina faster!
items.acquisition: Milk is collected from domesticated Common Goats, which are found in the Springlands.

items.name: Milkmaid Boots
items.description: Simple shoes with flat heels that pair well with dark stockings.
items.acquisition: Milkmaid Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Milkmaid Garb
items.description: A grassy green dress for housekeeping or working on the farm.
items.acquisition: Milkmaid Garb is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Milkmaid Hat
items.description: A milky white headwrap that keeps your hair out of your face while working.
items.acquisition: Milkmaid Hat is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Mill
items.description: A mill that can be used to grind materials to a fine powder.
items.acquisition: Crafting the Mill completes for the Alchemist, after obtaining . Additional Mills can be crafted at the Alchemist after the quest.

items.name: Miner Helmet
items.description: A miner's helmet with an attached light.

items.name: Mining Sieve
items.description: A hand scraper and sieve that can be used to mine gold and other materials underwater.

items.name: Minor Arcana
items.description: Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.

items.name: Minstrel Hat
items.description: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.
items.acquisition: Minstrel Hat is a unique drop that can be found in Vukah Cave west of .

items.name: Mint Mushroom Meat
items.description: Mint Mushroom Meat that can be used to dye all sorts of fabrics green. The name suggests a minty fresh taste, but consumption is strongly discouraged.
items.acquisition: Mint Mushroom Meat is obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Nomad Highlands Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms. C:Early Access Launch

items.name: Mirage
items.description: All hope is fickle, a mirage on the horizon. This staff makes its bearer reject all convictions to walk into the abyss.

items.name: Misfortune Mace
items.description: A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.

items.name: Mist of a Fell Sicklescythe
items.description: A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell Sicklescythe. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Fell Sicklescythe, first found in the Kindlewastes. The quest will take you to a , where one can be found.

items.name: Mixed Sandstone Block
items.acquisition: Found in

items.name: Monstrous Ribs
items.description: Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Fell Monstrosity, first found in the Nomad Highlands biome.

items.name: Morningdew Greatsword
items.description: No matter how dire the night may be, with the rising sun comes sweet morning dew.

items.name: Mortar
items.description: A fine mortar. This should enable an Alchemist to broaden their crafting spectrum when placed within their reach.
items.acquisition: The Mortar is obtained from the Alchemist's Tower in , Revelwood, as part of for the Alchemist.

items.name: Moss
items.description: A lovely patch of green moss. It can be used for highly effective bandages.

items.name: Mossy Stone
items.description: The dark brown and green give the appearance of an overgrown garden or a mystical clearing. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Mossy Stone dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Moth
items.description: An inconspicuous moth ripped from its natural ecosystem to be used as an alchemic ingredient. Can only be found at night in the fields of the Revelwood.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Revelwood at night. C:Early Access Launch

items.name: Mother-Of-Pearl
items.description: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.

items.name: Mother's Eye
items.description: Silvery like the sea of glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Boots
items.description: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Chest
items.description: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always crast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Gloves
items.description: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercly.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Helmet
items.description: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Shield
items.description: A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.

items.name: Mountain's Shadow Trousers
items.description: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.

items.name: Mushroom Flesh
items.description: The flesh of giant mushrooms that grow in the Blackmire. It's a bit spongy, but otherwise solid enough for building.

items.name: Mushroom Omelette
items.description: A delicious meal with an earthly taste.

items.name: Mycelium (Material)
items.description: Mycelium of mushrooms that have been absorbing the magical properties of the Shroud. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
items.acquisition: In the Shroud, mine ground to gain Mycelium. fr:Mycélium (Matériaux)

items.name: Mycelium (Overgrowth Material)
items.description: Use the Overgrowth Tool to apply this to structures in your base.

items.name: Mycelium Overgrown Block
items.description: A block of stone infested by Shroud spores.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Mycelium for the first time. Mycelium can be mined from fungal growths in Shrouded areas.

items.name: Mysterious Mauve
items.description: A color palette that makes you feel like a scholar, wandering through wisteria-laden archways to take samples of the flora. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Mysterious Mauve dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Mysterious Tome
items.description: A mysterious old book that cannot be opened. No matter how hard you pull at the petrified covers, the tome doesn't seem willing to spill its secrets.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Mystic Boots
items.description: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.

items.name: Mystic Chest
items.description: An exquisite mystical coat made of fine, dyed material. The metal clasps alone are highly valuable.

items.name: Mystic Gloves
items.description: Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.

items.name: Mystic Hat
items.description: A Wizard Hat. Most commonly worn during lunar ceremonies and divinations.

items.name: Mystic Pants
items.description: A pair of proper trousers. The metal delicate accents around the waist resembles the moon and the tide.

items.name: Mythic Wand
items.description: Many amethyst stones were used to forge this wand. They are needed to prevent combustion when this weapon inevitably overheast from the bundled energy inside!

items.name: Nails
items.description: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.
items.acquisition: Nails can be obtained by collecting loot or by crafting at the Blacksmith.

items.name: Natural Water Dispenser
items.description: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.

items.name: Necromancer's Skull Summoning Vessel
items.description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted by the Collector.

items.name: Nettle Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Stinging Nettle for the first time. Stinging Nettle can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: New Moon
items.description: When the silence of night begins to envelop the mountains, you best not step outside into the dark. Terror hides where the light does not reach. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The New Moon dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: New Moon Greatsword
items.description: A hollow shape, empty as the night sky on a new moon, adorns this weapon's hand guard. The blade has been dirtied, but refuses to shed its silvery sheen.

items.name: Nightfall
items.description: A dagger set made from darkened steel, reflecting the moonlight on its fractured edges.

items.name: Nightnebula
items.description: A mystical pair of blades used for unspeakable divinations held under the full moon.

items.name: Nightshade
items.description: A dagger's point coated in poison is often more effective than diplomacy. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Nightshade dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Nightwind Bow
items.description: A bow that's fueled by the dark shimmer of the Shroud.

items.name: Nitrate
items.description: A dangerous alchemical substance used to produce explosives. Better watch out!
items.acquisition: Nitrate is created in a Laboratory.

items.name: Noble Boots
items.description: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.

items.name: Noble Diadem
items.description: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.

items.name: Noble Dress
items.description: A long, flowing garment. The lower seam effortlessly hovers around the ankles while you walk.

items.name: Noble Gloves
items.description: These lightweight gloves are perfect for holding a quill and signing decrees.

items.name: Noble Pants
items.description: These sleek trousers are usually worn underneath more lavish dresses or tunics.

items.name: Noble Sword
items.description: A dignified blade, used to defend the honor and lives of the weak.

items.name: Nomad Highlands Bone Key
items.description: Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.

items.name: Nomad Highlands Broad Tree Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed. It is unlocked after unlocking the Beehive Smoker.

items.name: Nomad Highlands Dirt
items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
items.acquisition: Nomad Highlands Dirt can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Nomad Highlands Rubble
items.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
items.acquisition: Nomad Highlands Rubble can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Nomad Highlands Slender Tree Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed. It is available for crafting in the Seedbed after unlocking the Beehive Smoker.

items.name: Notice Board
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Nova
items.description: This sword, bright and blinding, erupts on the battlefield to unleash the original brilliance of the Flame.

items.name: Oak Tree Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Oath Breaker
items.description: These are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder.

items.name: Obsidian
items.description: Volcanic, pitch-black glass formed centuries ago. It leaves sharp edges when fractured, making it interesting for smithing and crafting.
items.acquisition: Mined from Obsidian veins, found in the Albaneve Summits.

items.name: Obsidian Arrow
items.description: An arrow tipped with a sharp shard of Obsidian.

items.name: Obsidian Block
items.description: A pitch-black block of solid obsidian. Building with this will add a mystical aura to your home!
items.acquisition: Found in a gold chest at the highest point of Forge of Obsidia in Albaneve Summits. You can fly in from above or grapple from below at the center of the second floor of the main forge building.

items.name: Obsidian Dust
items.description: Finely ground obsidian powder. It can more easily be alchemized in this form.

items.name: Old Books
items.description: A stack of old parchments, worn and torn by the ravages of time. A wise man could salvage something from the remnants

items.name: Omen Boots
items.description: Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, whether one is superstitious or not. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Omen Chest
items.description: An ordinary leather coat. A fungal growth overtook the flat grain texture. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Omen Gloves
items.description: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.

items.name: Omen Helmet
items.description: A living shell to encase the wearer's face like an iron maiden. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Omen Trousers
items.description: Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: One-Handed Melee Weapon Rack
items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

items.name: One-Handed Melee Weapon Wall Mount
items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

items.name: Ony's Map Piece
items.description: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all the pieces?
items.acquisition: Ony's Map Piece is found at . The piece is located in a nest on top of the large skeleton.

items.name: Open Sandwich
items.description: A relatively simple, but strengthening meal. Fast and ready to go!

items.name: Oracle's Everblue
items.description: "Gaze into the orb," the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. "It shows the past, the present, and the future and they're all veiled in blue rot".
items.acquisition: Oracle's Everblue is obtained randomly from Lootable Chests or Bosses in . C:wake Of Water Update

items.name: Ornate Flute
items.description: Miles Rapore's old flute, used to decorate the soundscapes of the Honeydews' many musical performances. He's often credited with keeping the band together, but his reclusive attitude towards crowds and stringent focus on marketability earned him a bad reputation.

items.name: Ornate Greatsword
items.description: The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.

items.name: Ornate Hand Drum
items.description: A fine drum with a patterned leather cover, famously owned by Daniel the Damned, a former member of the Honeydews. Fans speculated that tha back of the drum was inscribed with runes that would make Daniel play faster, like a possessed man. Now that you're holding it, those rumors proves to be false but his damnation was very real, at least!

items.name: Ornate Handpan
items.description: This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.
items.acquisition: Found in the Veilwater Basin at the .

items.name: Ornate Harp
items.description: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of the Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.

items.name: Ornate Lute
items.description: An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of the Honeydews the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftmanship of the instrument are well preserved.

items.description: A top-quality bow inspired by antlers. One might call it art.

items.description: This significant upgrade to the Fireplace offers new food options that can be cooked passively.
items.acquisition: The Oven can be crafted by the Farmer after completing .

items.acquisition: Unlocked once you craft Goo.

items.name: Padding
items.description: A basic ingredient for all advanced armor. The padding added below the hard shell can create comfort and soften impacts. A Loom is needed to craft both padding and advanced armor.

items.acquisition: This block can be unlocked after obtaining Palm Leaves

items.acquisition: Palm Leaves is obtained from chopping down palm trees in Veilwater Basin. Can be obtained from fully grown Licuala Seedling. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.description: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.
items.acquisition: Paper Reed is gathered from reeds near water, or in bamboo forests. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked in the Seedbed by harvesting reeds near a lake or river for the first time. These can be found throughout Embervale.

items.name: Parade Daggers
items.description: These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon.

items.name: Passionflower
items.description: Take a moment to appreciate this fascinating flower and its beautiful pink color.
items.acquisition: Passionflower are harvested from plants in the Veilwater Basin at night. The plant grows pink and is easily seen from afar.

items.name: Pastel Yearwake
items.description: Life still blooms everywhere around. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Pastel Yearwake dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station. The Pastel Yearwake dye can be found at .

items.name: Pearl
items.description: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.
items.acquisition: Draks have a low chance to drop. Otherwise they can be found underwater in clams.

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Boots
items.description: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Chest
items.description: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Gloves
items.description: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Hat
items.description: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.

items.name: Pearlfrost Mentor Pants
items.description: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.

items.name: Pendant Ceiling Lantern
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

items.name: Penny Bun
items.description: A great snack that stimulates the brain. Increases your intelligence by a small amount.
items.acquisition: Penny Bun is obtained from Penny Bun mushrooms, found in the Springlands biome. Penny Bun can also be grown from Penny Bun Seedlings.

items.name: Penny Bun Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Penny Bun for the first time. Penny Bun can be found in the Springlands.

items.name: Petrified Shroud Stalker Shell
items.description: A dense, stone-like carapace torn from the Stalker, a ruthless assassin of the Shroud. Its near-unbreakable structure makes it a crucial material for forging tough and resilient armor.
items.acquisition: Dropped by the Shroud Stalker, first found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.description: A basic mining tool, made of the simplest of materials. It's not very durable or efficient, but does what it's supposed to do.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time. It is then crafted by Manual Crafting.

items.name: Pikemead Statue Showcase
items.description: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen Pikemead statue.
items.acquisition: Pikemead Statue Showcase is crafted by the Carpenter.

items.name: Pikemead's Bulwark
items.description: Even in death, the queen unites those who seek protection behind her shield.

items.name: Pillbug
items.description: A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Albaneve Summits. Can be found at night. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Pine Shortbow
items.description: A practical and quick bow made from humble pine wood. Its tensions is weak, so using it require little stamina.

items.name: Pinky Promise
items.description: The chalky white and vibrant pink in this palette form a childlike innocence. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Pinky Promise dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Piscine Ivory Dust
items.description: Piscine Ivory, often called the ivory of the sea, ground into a bright powder. Renowned for its strength and resilience, it can even serve as a component in metal alloys, lending them exceptional robustness.

items.name: Plaguebringer Boots
items.description: These boots are always damp, even on the inside. Walking in them feels like wading through a bog. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Plaguebringer Chest
items.description: Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armour, thus forging it in a new image. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Plaguebringer Gloves
items.description: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.

items.name: Plaguebringer Hood
items.description: Putrescence laps the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Plaguebringer Trousers
items.description: Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

items.name: Plaited Block
items.description: A building block made from tightly woven twigs. It's used inside Vukah buildings.
items.acquisition: Found in Abandoned Vukah Village in the Blackmire

items.name: Plant Fiber
items.description: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.
items.acquisition: Plant Fiber is gathered from bushes found throughout Embervale. It can also be picked up as a physical item in the world. Bushes can also be grown from Shrub Seedlings. fr:Fibre de plante

items.name: Plant Fiber Roof Block
items.description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Plant Fiber for the first time. Plant Fiber can be gathered from small shrubs.

items.name: Plantain
items.description: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.

items.name: Plantain Curry
items.description: A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.

items.name: Plough
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Pocket Heater
items.description: After ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.

items.name: Poison Sack
items.description: It's considered to be one of the most dangerous materials in the world! Touching it directly is usually not a good idea.

items.name: Poisoned Golden Steel Arrow
items.description: This golden, steel-tipped arrow has been dipped in poison. A strike with this will be most deadly.

items.description: A wand the especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance.

items.description: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.
items.acquisition: Popcorn is crafted by the Farmer. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Farmer during to unlock.

items.name: Portable Water Pump
items.description: A tool that allows you to add and remove water in your base. It can also be utilized for irrigation and applying the Wet or Soaked Debuff to enemies. Fill it with water from a well or lake before beginning operation.

items.name: Prawn Fossil
items.description: The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.

items.description: Offers a small prayer to the Flame, that increases your magic damage and the maximum time in the Shroud for a short duration.

items.description: These vivid colors - deep cyan, bright magenta, and rich black - make a statement all on their own. With this palette, you won't go unnoticed. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Pretty In Pink dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Princely Greatsword
items.description: A noble sabre that impresses with its golden glow and broad blade. Perhaps the former owner was compensating for something.

items.description: Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor.

items.name: Provisional Scythe
items.description: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.

items.name: Prowl
items.description: The array of reds, oranges, and grays creates the ideal camouflage against the sundried mountains. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

items.name: Pumpkin Soup
items.description: A tasty pumpkin soup. It's creamy and rich in flavor. It will also keep you warm. What’s not to love?

items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Bonus.

items.name: Purple Wall Light II
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Bonus.

items.name: Pyreblade
items.description: The Pyreblade is capable of unleashing devastating fire strikes while reflecting a portion of the foe's own fury back upon them.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Scavenger Pyreblade in Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece (Arm)
items.description: A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece (Base)
items.description: A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Queen Pikemead Statue Piece (Bust)
items.description: A broken piece of the Queen Pikemead sculpture.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the .

items.name: Quetzal Hunter Chest
items.description: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm laves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.

items.name: Quetzal Hunter Gloves
items.description: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.

items.name: Quetzal Hunter Helmet
items.description: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.

items.name: Quetzal Hunter Pants
items.description: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.

items.name: Quetzal Hunter Shoes
items.description: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.

items.name: Quick Stack Station
items.description: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby.

items.name: Radiant Paladin Boots
items.description: Expertly crafted boots. They've been embellished with flame-spouting shields, a roaring inferno only kept at bay through vigilance.

items.name: Radiant Paladin Chestplate
items.description: Showcase your beaming soul of flames and cast out all evil once and for all! The light thunders and roars with every heartbeat.

items.name: Radiant Paladin Gloves
items.description: These gloves radiate warmth and safety as if they were forged in pure liquid light.

items.name: Radiant Paladin Helmet
items.description: A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.

items.name: Radiant Paladin Trousers
items.description: This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.

items.name: Ragged Boots
items.description: They can barely be called boots.

items.name: Ragged Pants
items.description: Enough to brace for the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.

items.name: Ragged Shirt
items.description: Can this even be called a shirt?

items.name: Rake
items.description: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.
items.acquisition: Rake is crafted at the Workbench. The crafting recipe requires either reaching level 5 or obtaining to unlock.

items.name: Ranger Boots
items.description: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.

items.name: Ranger Gloves
items.description: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.

items.name: Ranger Hood
items.description: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.

items.name: Ranger Trousers
items.description: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.

items.name: Ranger Vest
items.description: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.

items.name: Rare Fishing Bait
items.description: Bait that increases the chance of catching rare fish.

items.name: Rattlesnake Bow
items.description: The bow curves into a zig-zag on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.

items.name: Raw Bird Meat
items.description: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

items.name: Raw Dune Armadillo Meat
items.description: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.

items.name: Raw Fatty Meat
items.description: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.

items.name: Raw Game
items.description: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.

items.name: Raw Lean Meat
items.description: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.

items.name: Raw Meat and Corncob Skewer
items.description: A hearty feast that fortifies your body. Grilled over a fire, this skewer will increase your melee damage, boost your maximum health, and accelerate your health regeneration.

items.name: Raw Meat and Mushroom Skewer
items.description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.

items.name: Raw Meat and Tomato Skewer
items.description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

items.name: Raw Rice
items.description: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked.
items.acquisition: Can be harvested from Rice Seedling C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Raw Taro
items.description: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.

items.name: Raw Wolf Meat
items.description: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.

items.name: Raw Wool
items.description: Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.
items.acquisition: Raw Wool can be obtained sometimes by killing Yaks or taming them, when provided shelter, a bed and food they will provide Raw Wool for you.

items.name: Reaper's Wand
items.description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded!

items.name: Recent Drak Wand
items.description: A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts.

items.name: Red Carpet Block
items.description: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by picking it up for the first time. It can be found behind a door requiring 4 switches to open on top of the eastern wall of .

items.name: Red Confetti Mortar
items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

items.name: Red Fabric
items.description: Red - the color of the Flame fitting for a Flameborn!

items.name: Red Flower Pot (Square)
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Red Fountain
items.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

items.name: Red Marble Block
items.description: This block made from polished red marble fragments has a mysterious, yet graceful look.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Red Marble Block in the . It is found in a silver chest in a room shortly before the Hollow Cyclops.

items.name: Red Marble Fragment
items.description: The simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Hollow Halls

items.name: Reed Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: Unknown

items.name: Refined Sandstone Block
items.description: A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Refined Stone Block
items.description: A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked after obtaining the Masonry Tools, an objective of .

items.name: Refined Wood Block
items.description: Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Wood Planks for the first time. Wood Planks can be crafted using Wood Logs with the Table Saw or found in the world.

items.name: Regular Sandstone Block
items.description: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost - efficient.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Regular Stone Block
items.description: A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.
items.acquisition: This block is obtained by looting the Regular Stone Block from the . It is found in a wooden chest on a platform on the side of the Bridge.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.
items.acquisition: Crafted at the Hunter.

items.name: Reptile Hide
items.description: The tough and scaly skin of a reptile.
items.acquisition: Reptile Hide is dropped from Snapjaws.

items.name: Reptile Leather
items.description: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.

items.name: Resin
items.description: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
items.acquisition: Resin can be obtained through chopping down trees. It can be more quickly obtained by chopping trees with red leaves and grown Revelwood Red Leaf Seedlings. fr:Résine

items.name: Resin Torch
items.description: An advanced torch that provides light for a longer period. Use this to explore deeper into the abyss!

items.name: Resource Bundle I
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Resource Bundle II
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Revelation By The Pond
items.description: Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren’t as they seem - for both depths and dewdroppee thicket hide fateful encounters. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Revelation By The Pond dye can be found at .

items.name: Revelwood Bone Key
items.description: Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.

items.name: Revelwood Dirt
items.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.
items.acquisition: Revelwoods Dirt can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Revelwood Green Leaf Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Revelwood Red Leaf Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Revelwood Rubble
items.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.
items.acquisition: Revelwood Rubble can be found in the Revelwood.

items.name: Revelwood Stone
items.description: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
items.acquisition: Revelwood Stone can be crafted at the workbench, after obtaining Revelwood Dirt.

items.name: Revitalizing Health Potion
items.description: The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations. Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.

items.name: Revitalizing Health Potion +
items.description: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

items.name: Rice Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water, so that the roots are always covered.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting raw Rice for the first time.

items.name: Right Cyclops Arm
items.description: The right arm of a Cyclops. It's taller than your whole body when propped up!

items.name: Right Cyclops Leg
items.description: The right leg of a wild Cyclops. The skeletal remains are intact.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the xxx.

items.name: Ring of Endless Life
items.description: Created in the pursuit of immortality, it cost countless lives and promises more to follow. It enhances every attack and has a chance to restore the damage dealt as health points.

items.name: Ring of Frost
items.description: It hugs your finger like an icy embrace and lets you become one with the cold. It imbues the wearer with increased frost resistance.

items.name: Ring of Health
items.description: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.

items.name: Ring of Mana
items.description: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.

items.name: Ring of Rapacity
items.description: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.

items.name: Ring of Stamina
items.description: An ancient ring that gives you stamina.

items.name: Ring of the Ancients
items.description: An amazing work of art, beauty and power.

items.name: Ring of the Burning Light
items.description: Filled with ancient magic, this ring provides light to you in dark places.

items.name: Ring of the Flame
items.description: Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.

items.name: Ring of the Heir
items.description: A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.

items.name: Ring of Thundersnow
items.description: Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.

items.name: Ripped Alchemist's Wall Hanging (Left)
items.description: A ripped piece of fabric, detailing alchemical wisdom. Someone might be able to decipher it if you had the other half!
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at the lighthouse near .

items.name: Ripped Alchemist's Wall Hanging (Right)
items.description: The second half of a wall hanging, visualizing the complex symbiosis of the natural, and magical. When paired with the other half, perhaps this ancient wisdom can be understood.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found at the dragon nest near .

items.name: Riptide
items.description: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. Must have belonged to a valiant hero.

items.name: Rising Fighter Boots
items.description: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.

items.name: Rising Fighter Chest
items.description: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits - the perfect chest armor for begginer.

items.name: Rising Fighter Gloves
items.description: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.

items.name: Rising Fighter Helmet
items.description: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.

items.name: Rising Fighter Shield
items.description: Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.

items.name: Rising Fighter Trousers
items.description: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.

items.name: Ritual Tempest Wand
items.description: This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for drownpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies.

items.name: Roasted Azure Russula
items.description: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.

items.name: Roasted Coffee Beans
items.description: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

items.name: Roasted Corncob
items.description: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.

items.name: Roasted Shiitake Mushroom
items.description: A roasted shiitake mushroom. The new, smoky aftertaste brings out the umami flavor.

items.name: Rocky Shore
items.description: The deep blue hue that takes center stage in this palette can be found beyond rocky beaches, or on rainy days by the cliff. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.acquisition: The Rocky Shore dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Rocky Stone Road Block
items.description: A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Stone for the first time.

items.name: Rogue Boots
items.description: Adventures who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.

items.name: Rogue Chestplate
items.description: A well - balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.

items.name: Rogue Gloves
items.description: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend !

items.name: Rogue Helmet
items.description: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts and scars.

items.name: Rogue Shield
items.description: A light shield that effortlessly allows the wearer to stay nimble whilst under fire.

items.name: Rogue Trousers
items.description: The metal plates provide added protection against jagged or poisoned arrows.

items.name: Roof Tiles Block
items.description: A Roof Tiles Block needed to build shingle roofs, commonly see in construction.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring a Lump of Clay for the first time.

items.name: Rooibos
items.description: An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.
items.acquisition: Rooibos is obtained from Rooibos bushes, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Rooibos bushes can also be grown from Rooibos Seedlings.

items.name: Rooibos Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Rooibos for the first time. Rooibos can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Rooibos Tea
items.description: An aromatic ingredient that calms the body, providing an instant boost of Stamina for the user.

items.name: Room Divider Dragon
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Lunar New Year Trader during . It is then crafted at the Lunar New Year Trader.

items.name: Room Divider Fish
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Lunar New Year Trader during . It is then crafted at the Lunar New Year Trader.

items.name: Room Divider Flower
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Lunar New Year Trader during . It is then crafted at the Lunar New Year Trader.

items.name: Room Divider I
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Room Divider II
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Room Divider III
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Room Divider Snake
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Lunar New Year Trader during . It is then crafted at the Lunar New Year Trader.

items.name: Root Staff
items.description: This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it.

items.name: Rotblood
items.description: The Shroud slumbers inside. Rotblood is molded by it, changed, and its essence forever tinted.

items.name: Rough Flintstone Block
items.description: These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Flintstone for the first time. Flintstone is commonly found in the starting areas of the Springlands.

items.name: Rough Sandstone Block
items.description: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Sandstone for the first time. Sandstone can be found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Rough Stone Block
items.description: A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Stone for the first time. Stone is a basic material found throughout Embervale.

items.name: Rough Wood Block
items.description: A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Wood Logs for the first time. Wood Logs can be obtained by chopping trees or found in the world, such as by breaking destructible wooden structures.

items.name: Roughly Cut Stone Block
items.description: A block made out of rocks extracted from the grounds. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation!
items.acquisition: Reading adds a hint to the Set List. This block is then obtained by looting the Roughly Cut Stone Block in . It is found in a large glowing crate on top of a ruined building in Netherton. The crate can be spotted from the nearby Ancient Obelisk.

items.name: Round Carved Window Frame
items.description: Decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Round Food Plate
items.description: A wooden plate to display cooked food on a table.

items.name: Round Iron Window Frame
items.description: Decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Round Polished Window Frame
items.description: Decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by accepting . It is then crafted at the Carpenter.

items.name: Round Sea Urchin
items.description: Globular and small, this sea urchin looks unassuming. A keen eye, however, will notice the fivefold symmetry.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Springlands.

items.name: Round Steel Window Frame
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Round Stone Window Frame
items.description: Decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Round Wooden Door
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: This recipe is unlocked by crafting a .

items.name: Round Wooden Door Frame
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: This recipe is unlocked by crafting a .

items.name: Round Wooden Window Frame
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: This recipe is unlocked by crafting a or by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

items.name: Royal Boots
items.description: Stomp out anti-feudalist uprisings in style with these fashionable and finely crafted shoes!
items.acquisition: Royal Boots is a unique drop and looted from a in .

items.name: Royal Crown
items.description: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
items.acquisition: Royal Crown is a unique drop and looted from a in .

items.name: Royal Decree
items.description: None can deny your authority when you're dressed in sacred white and royal lavender. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
items.acquisition: The Royal Decree dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station after being found/unlocked at the .

items.name: Royal Doublet
items.description: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.
items.acquisition: Royal Doublet is a unique drop and looted from a in .

items.name: Royal Gloves
items.description: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasents. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.
items.acquisition: Royal Gloves is a unique drop and looted from a in .

items.name: Royal Pants
items.description: Billowy pants that were made from the finest silks. They create an interesting and lavish silhouette.
items.acquisition: Royal Pants is a unique drop and looted from a in .

items.name: Rubble
items.description: The dusty remains of building materials.
items.acquisition: Obtained by mining with a pickaxe from ruined buildings. Used in creating "Roughly Cut Stone Block"

items.name: Ruffian's Axe
items.description: A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon will do the trick.

items.name: Rune Apprentice's Sword
items.description: The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.

items.name: Rune Master's Sword
items.description: The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.

items.name: Runes
items.description: Runes attract and store magical energy from all around them. Used to enhance weapons.
items.acquisition: Runes can be obtained from defeating Fell enemies, looting chests, or dismantling weapons.

items.name: Rust
items.description: Colored like rusted metal, slate, and copper. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Rust dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Rust And Rose
items.description: This color palette blends muted orange, soft mauve, and earthy brown into a palette that feels both weathered and graceful - like warmth preserved in fading light. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
items.acquisition: The Rust And Rose dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Rustic Banquet Table
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.acquisition: Rustic Banquet Table is crafted at the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Bard during to unlock.

items.name: Rustic Bed
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.acquisition: Rustic Bed is crafted at the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Bard during to unlock.

items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: Rustic Window Frame I is crafted at the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Bard during to unlock.

items.name: Rustic Window Frame II
items.description: Decorative object to design and beautify your home.
items.acquisition: Rustic Window Frame II is crafted at the Carpenter. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Bard during to unlock.

items.name: Rusty Greatsword
items.description: An old greatsword that's begun to decay. The steel's purity has been stripped away by rust.

items.name: Rusty Short Sword
items.description: A forgotten sword from long gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.

items.name: Rusty Sword
items.description: A rusted Simple Copper Sword, damaged by time itself. Its best days are far gone.

items.name: Sacred Vukah Scroll
items.description: Offers a prayer to the ancient Vukah. If answered, the user receives a buff in stamina and strength.

items.name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
items.description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual.
items.acquisition: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger is found during the quest , at .

items.name: Sacrilegious Steelsword
items.description: A blade forged from the stolen steel of fallen soldiers. It spreads regret and misery.
items.acquisition: Sacrilegious Steelsword is obtained randomly from Lootable Chests or Bosses in Hollow Halls.

items.name: Saffron
items.description: A rare herbal plant that can be found in hot areas of the world.
items.acquisition: Saffron is obtained from Saffron plants, found in the Kindlewastes biome. Large amounts can be found at and . Saffron plants can also be grown from Saffron Seedlings.

items.name: Saffron Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Saffron Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Saffron for the first time. Saffron can be found in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Sage Boots
items.description: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in library.

items.name: Sage Gloves
items.description: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.

items.name: Sage Headwrap
items.description: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.

items.name: Sage Leaves
items.description: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.
items.acquisition: Sage Leaves is obtained from Sage plants, found in the Nomad Highlands biome. Sage plants can also be grown from Sage Seedlings.

items.name: Sage Pants
items.description: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The weaver, mostly.

items.name: Sage Plant Pot
items.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

items.name: Sage Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed by harvesting Sage Leaves for the first time. Sage Leaves can be found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Sage Tunic
items.description: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.

items.name: Salon Sign
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Salon Sink
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.
items.acquisition: Salon Sink is crafted at the Carpenter.

items.name: Salon Stool
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Salt
items.description: Crystalline powder which can be found in enshrouded valleys. The taste of food can be improved drastically when sprinkled with salt.
items.acquisition: Salt is mined from salt deposits in the Springlands, such as or . The objective of the first quest given by the Hunter - - shows you the location of a large salt deposit at and requires you to collect salt there. fr:Sel

items.name: Sand
items.description: Sand, glittering like gold on a hot summers day, is shifty even in the best of hours.
items.acquisition: Mined from the the ground in the Kindlewastes.

items.name: Sand Throne
items.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

items.name: Sandstone
items.description: Sandstone are stones that consist mainly out of big sand particles - a beautiful natural material and another wonder of nature to admire.
items.acquisition: Mined from cliffs and rock formations throughout the Kindlewastes. fr:Grès

items.name: Sandstone Brazier
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.name: Sandstone Fence
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Sandstone Fence Corner
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Sandstorm Swiftblades
items.description: A dagger set of old-timey Eastern craftmanship. Rogues of that era would swing this short cutlass around during battle, causing nearby sand to swirl up and blind the enemy.

items.name: Scabird On One Leg
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Scaffold I
items.description: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

items.name: Scaffold II
items.description: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by reaching level 5. It is then crafted at the Workbench.

items.name: Scales
items.description: Hardened scales of wild animals. Some say they are as hard as stone.
items.acquisition: Scales are dropped by Dune Armadillos and Scorpions in the Kindlewastes. They are also collected from domesticated Dune Armadillos.

items.name: Scarab
items.description: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.
items.acquisition: Can be found in the Kindlewastes, mostly night (includes dusk), on rocky patches of grass and rocky flat areas. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Scare Crow
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Scarecrow
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Scavenger Bonfire
items.description: A big burning pile that's both cozy and archaic.
items.acquisition: Scavenger Bonfire is crafted at the Workbench. The crafting recipe requires approaching a Scavenger Bonfire in a Scavenger camp to unlock. Bonfires can be found at and .

items.name: Scavenger Gong
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Scavenger Matron Helmet
items.description: She is less fearsome when headless. The acidic scent lingers, however.

items.name: Scavenger Matron Trophy
items.description: It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.

items.name: Scavenger Miner Axe
items.description: This Scavenger Miner Axe wil llet you pry ore from stone by day and pierce traitors' backs by night.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Scavenger Miners in the Albaneve Summits and Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots
items.description: With these boots the "Scholars of the Empyrean" were able to pass the trapped corridors of the Night Sanctums. Their soles, often worn thin, were replaced countless times. Hopefully, they'll carry you just as far on your own journey.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Empyrean Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak
items.description: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Empyrean Cloak is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Gloves
items.description: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Empyrean Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet
items.description: The radiant golden glow of this helmet recalls the bright spirit of the previous owner. In Embervale, this helmet was reserved for only the brightest thinkers, whose intellect lit the way.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Empyrean Helmet is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants
items.description: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Empyrean Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Young Flame Boots
items.description: These golden boots carried the "Scholars of the Young Flame" across the open roads of Embervale. The soles still carry dust from places you have yet to discover.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Young Flame Boots is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Young Flame Cloak
items.description: A resplendent white-and-gold interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it sybolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Young Flame Cloak is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Young Flame Gloves
items.description: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Young Flame Gloves is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Young Flame Helmet
items.description: A radiant headpiece that can be spotted from afar. Not only when the burning sun reflects off it.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Young Flame Helmet is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar Of The Young Flame Pants
items.description: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.
items.acquisition: Scholar Of The Young Flame Pants is a unique drop that can be found in the .

items.name: Scholar's Wand
items.description: Scholars of the North once researched the use of pyro magic against particularly harsh winters. It took countless explosive experiments to discover the same benefit most people might achieve with a bonfire. Downsides such as third-degree burns were common, so research was quickly stopped.

items.name: Scientific Instruments
items.description: Basic tools needed for a laboratory.
items.acquisition: Scientific Instruments are obtained from in the Nomad Highlands, as part of for the Alchemist.

items.name: Scorching Wand
items.description: This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long.

items.name: Scout Boots
items.description: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.

items.name: Scout Chest
items.description: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.

items.name: Scout Gloves
items.description: Excellent tools to scout with - especially due to their grip and padding.

items.name: Scout Hood
items.description: The perfect disguise - even in broad daylight.

items.name: Scout Pants
items.description: Silent pants to tread quietly.

items.description: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with a piece of scrap metal at the tip.

items.description: An axe made out of scrap metal with improved durability and efficiency compared to the Axe

items.name: Scrappy Crate
items.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

items.name: Scrappy Greatsword
items.description: A broken blade, retrieved from the rubble and ash of the old world. It may still cause significant damage when in the wrong hands.

items.name: Scrappy Pickaxe
items.description: Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance, but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.

items.name: Scrappy Sword
items.description: A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.
items.acquisition: Scrappy Sword is crafted by the Blacksmith. The crafting recipe requires retrieving the Blacksmith during to unlock.

items.name: Sea Urchin Cluster
items.description: A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Springlands.

items.name: Seafoam
items.description: Refreshing like a salty gust of wind from the ocean. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
items.acquisition: The Seafoam dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station. The Seafoam dye can be found at the .

items.name: Seafood Grill
items.description: A sturdy grill, perfect for preparing advanced seafood dishes. With it, your food will come out extra crispy and full of flavor.
items.acquisition: Complete the quest .

items.name: Seared Fish Cutlet
items.description: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavourful.

items.name: Seared Fish Filet
items.description: Seared on the grill to perfection, enjoy this exquisite piece of fish filet.

items.description: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
