items.name: Sediment
items.description: The color of arid roads and sandy tombs. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
items.acquisition: The Sediment dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Seedbed
items.description: Lets seedlings germinate in a safe environment.
items.acquisition: The recipe is unlocked by retrieving the Farmer during . It is then crafted at the Farmer.

items.name: Serpent Warrior Boots
items.description: These boots have an intricate scale pattern on their green plating.

items.name: Serpent Warrior Chest
items.description: The ruby-red cloth, emerald-colored scales, and golden trim create a warm and regal cosmetic armor piece when combined.

items.name: Serpent Warrior Gloves
items.description: The sharp edges of these gloves that stretch towards the wearer's fingertips jot out like viper fangs.

items.name: Serpent Warrior Helmet
items.description: This helmet lets you portray a particularly patient and calculating gaze.

items.name: Serpent Warrior Pants
items.description: A pair of grey trousers. They layer well under the more elaborate cloth of the upper body armor.

items.name: Shades Of Red
items.description: Shadowy reds make this palette ideal for a moody night-time journey. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin]] materials. | Type = Generic Item | Rarity = Common | Stack Size = 50
items.acquisition: The Shades Of Red dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Shadowbane
items.description: An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the Shroud.

items.name: Shadowbloom
items.description: The shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.
items.acquisition: Can be found at night in the Kindlewastes biome.

items.name: Shadowbloom Wrap
items.description: This wrap is a good alternative to the more commonly seen meat wrap. It still increases your health, and additionally, the shadowbloom stocks are very filling and extend your time in the Shroud.

items.name: Shadowtail
items.description: This is a rare, midnight-black variant of the Stripetail. Its dark scales absorb light, making it nearly invisible underwater. This patient predator strikes from the depths when you least expect it.
items.acquisition: Shadowtail can be obtained while fishing using Rare Baits like , and . C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Sharktooth Greatsword
items.description: The edges of this blade are indented and therefore resemble cuts made by razor-sharp fins or rows of shark teeth.

items.name: Sharp Shark Tooth
items.description: A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...
items.acquisition: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Sharpened Broadsword
items.description: A broadsword almost too big to be comfortably swung. The original owner must have been gigantic.

items.name: Sharpshooter Boots
items.description: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.

items.name: Sharpshooter Gloves
items.description: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.

items.name: Sharpshooter Hood
items.description: The metal adorment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.

items.name: Sharpshooter Trousers
items.description: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.

items.name: Sharpshooter Vest
items.description: The shoulder pads on this Sharpshooter Vest are exceptionally sharp and pointed like the tip of an arrow.

items.name: Shell Limestone
items.description: A type of limestone derived from seashells
items.acquisition: Shell Limestone can be found in Veilwater Basin. FR:Calcaire de coquille

items.name: Shell Limestone Block
items.description: This stone block is commonly used in Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Shell Limestone Road Block
items.description: This is a road material made from shell limestone, wich is commonly found in Vailwater Basin.
items.acquisition: Can be easily obtained by digging out Shell Limestone roads.

items.name: Shell Limestone Shingles
items.description: With these sturdy shingles, your house is well protected
items.acquisition: This block can be found in

items.name: Shellbreaker Daggers
items.description: Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.

items.name: Shepherd's Lightning
items.description: A mighty relic, able to provide solace amidst chaos. The previous owner might have been retired hero.

items.name: Shepherd's Staff
items.description: A potent staff capable of guiding those who would otherwise be without protection.

items.name: Shield
items.description: This makeshift shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

items.name: Shield of Light
items.description: This sacred shield consecrated by the Flame allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
items.acquisition: This item can be crafted by the Blacksmith the recipe is unlocked by obtaining for the first time.

items.name: Shield Rack
items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

items.name: Shield Wall Emblem (Maces)
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Shield Wall Emblem (Swords)
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Shield Wall Mount
items.description: A display to showcase weapons or shields.

items.name: Shiitake Mushroom
items.description: Shiitake mushrooms work wonders for deepening the flavor of any dish.

items.name: Shiitake Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed when harvesting Shiitake Mushroom for the first time, which can be found in Veilwater Basin.

items.name: Shimmerfin
items.description: Despite wearing black bands over their eyes like bandits, they are relatively easy to catch
items.acquisition: Lakehopper can be obtained while fishing using Common Baits like , and . C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Shivering Skeans
items.description: A frosty set of daggers said to be infused with the souls of those who died in the coldest winters.

items.name: Shivs
items.description: A dagger set that was scavenged from the ruins of the old world. It's dirty and dusty, but still doas the trick.

items.name: Shock Wisp
items.description: Summons an electrified wisp that follows you around and shoots shock projectiles.

items.name: Shockfin
items.description: Said to be born from lightning striking open water, the Shockfin is charged with electric energy. Be careful when trying to pull it out of the water.
items.acquisition: Shockfin can be obtained while fishing using Epic Baits like , and . C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Shocking Ice Wand
items.description: Crafted through a combination of lightning and ice. Two powerful elements clash with each other.

items.name: Short Sword
items.description: A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.

items.name: Shortcrust Pastry Base
items.description: Perfectly crisp and buttery- a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.

items.name: Shovel Garden Gnome
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Shroud Adhesive
items.description: A thick, viscius substance harvested from Shroud Flayers. Its tenacious bonding properties make it essential for crafting armor and securely sticking materials together in various crafting recipes.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Shroud Flayers, first found in the Nomad Highlands. Can be obtained from Shroud Flayer Seedling.

items.name: Shroud Arrow I
items.description: If you can't beat them, join them. This arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.
items.acquisition: = The crafting process for the Shroud Arrow I is slightly more complicated, yet still easily achievable in early game, but as the name suggests, it requires venturing into the Shroud. The recipe is unlocked upon crafting Goo for the first time.

items.name: Shroud Arrow II
items.description: If you can't beat them, join them. This special arrow uses the power of the Shroud and disperses a cloud of it upon impact.

items.name: Shroud Beam Channel
items.description: Hold to deal continuous Shroud damage in a beam of up to 20 meters range.

items.name: Shroud Core
items.description: A stable form of energy. Burning it at the Flame Altar may protect against the Shroud.
items.acquisition: Dropped by Fell bosses, commonly found guarding Shroud Roots and Elixir Wells. Can also be crafted by the Alchemist.

items.name: Shroud Corrupted Hammer
items.description: A mighty hammer, corrupted to the core. The power of the Shroud is channeled in the weapon.

items.name: Shroud Flayer Seedling
items.description: Once placed into Shroud-Infused farm soil, this seedling can grow into a Shroud Flayer.
items.acquisition: Crafted at the Seedbed, also obtained from Shroud Flayer.

items.name: Shroud Gelatin
items.description: A translucent, gelatinous substance extracted from Shroud Depthdwellers. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties. Essential for crafting healing spells and magical wards.
items.acquisition: Can be obtained from Shroud Depthdwellers.

items.name: Shroud Infused Farm Soil
items.description: Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth.
items.acquisition: Crafted at the Farmer.

items.name: Shroud Liquid
items.description: The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths. The brown fluid emits a violet vapour and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.
items.acquisition: Shroud Liquid can be found in the Shroud, looted from mushrooms on the ground and gathered using tools from larger mushrooms.

items.name: Shroud Meteor
items.description: Magical ammunition that calls a disastrous Shroud Meteor down on up to five foes. The meteors deal heavy Shroud damage.

items.name: Shroud Meteor Shower
items.description: This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor Shower. It releases a giant shower of Shroud Meteors on enemies around the caster. But be careful, it drains your remaining time in the Shroud upon usage.

items.name: Shroud Mushroom
items.description: A mushroom that is commonly found in the Shroud of the Revelwood biome. It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
items.acquisition: Shroud Mushrooms are obtained from chopping down mushroom stalks in the Revelwood Shroud. Just like trees, larger stalks will drop more mushrooms. Large stalks may drop as many as x8-12 Shroud Mushrooms.

items.name: Shroud Nexus
items.description: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
items.acquisition: Crafted at the Alchemist. They also drop from the Fell Monstrosity and the Fell Sicklescythe.

items.name: Shroud Particles
items.description: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores.
items.acquisition: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Nomad Highlands biome. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Shroud Radiance
items.description: The Highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus
items.acquisition: Crafted at the Alchemist.

items.name: Shroud Relic
items.description: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to Shroud Particles.
items.acquisition: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Veilwater Basin biome. C:Wake Of Water Update

items.name: Shroud Sack
items.description: An organic bag containing highly concentrated Shroud spores.

items.name: Shroud Sand
items.description: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores.
items.acquisition: Mined from glowing yellow patches of sand in the Kindlewastes Shroud.

items.name: Shroud Slime
items.description: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.

items.name: Shroud Sludge
items.description: Excessive experimentation proved that mixing slime and jelly creates sludge. All of these substances are entirely different and deserving of their own characterization due to their varied visconsity.

items.name: Shroud Spores
items.description: Shroud Spores are particles of energy that create and give the shroud its corrupting power.
items.acquisition: Shroud Spores are found by looting weaker Shroud creatures.

items.name: Shroud Survival Flask
items.description: Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user. Extends the remaining time in the Shroud after consumption by 2 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.

items.name: Shroud Vapor
items.description: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.

items.name: Shroud Weaver
items.description: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.
items.acquisition: The Shroud Weaver can be obtained by finding at . Completing the quest awards you with the staff.

items.name: Shroud Wood
items.description: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.
items.acquisition: Shroud Wood can be gathered in the Shroud by chopping down trees found there.

items.name: Shroud Wood Block
items.description: A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud.
items.acquisition: This block is unlocked by acquiring Shroud Wood for the first time. Shroud Wood can be obtained by chopping trees found in the Shroud.

items.name: Shroudbinder Wand
items.description: This magical wand fires projectiles that deal Shroud damage.

items.name: Shrub Seedling
items.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
items.acquisition: This seedling is unlocked at the Seedbed.

items.name: Sickle Greatsword
items.description: Once upon a time, Orpheus, a dark dragon, descended from the mountains to wreak havoc on the people's crops. Determined, the farmers laid down their scythes to join in the righteous crusade against the creature, forcing it to retreat with but one blow. While their names were forgotten, their fabled blades served as inspiration for many blacksmith apprentices.

items.name: Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard
items.description: "Captain Arkwright" is engraved in the metal. Given to the most loyal commanders.

items.name: Signpost Pole
items.description: A signpost that can be used to attach direction signs.

items.name: Silver Bars
items.description: Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.

items.name: Silver Bowl
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Silver Candleholder
items.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

items.name: Silver Chalice
items.description: The bright silver tone of this color palette decorated many of the realm's opulent chalices. It's known to pair well with the sanguine red of wine or the treacherous green glow of deceit and poison. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
items.acquisition: The Silver Chalice dye can be crafted at the Coloring Station.

items.name: Silver Chest
items.description: This small chest offers increased storage space for items.

items.name: Silver Cup
items.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

items.name: Silver Dust
